records.english:
Special chests, called Strongboxes, can be found throughout Path of Exile. Unlike ordinary chests, Strongboxes are protected by monsters that must be defeated before the Strongbox will relinquish its treasures. 

Although Strongboxes are not technically items, they do share some special traits in common with many of Path of Exile's items. Specifically, Strongboxes have mods and, like items, these mods can be changed with the use of currency.

There are several different kinds of Strongbox to find, each one providing different amounts or kinds of items. Here are a few of the more common ones:
records.zhTW:
在流亡黯道旅途中，可以發現一些特別的箱子「保險箱」。不像一般的箱子，保險箱會被一群怪物保護著，一定要打敗怪物後保險箱才會掉落寶物。

雖然保險箱技術上來說不是物品，但它和流亡黯道中的物品有些特殊的關聯性。舉例來說，保險箱像物品一樣有詞綴，也可以用通貨來改變這些詞綴。

保險箱的許多不同的種類，每種都會提供不同的數量或是種類的物品。以下是幾個常見的保險箱類型：

records.english: It is often worth carrying some currency items with you, so you can modify any strongboxes you happen to come across. The difference between a normal Strongbox and a well-crafted magic Strongbox can be quite significant.
records.zhTW: 帶些通貨在身上滿划算的，這樣你可以在遇到保險箱的時候調整成有利的詞綴。一般的保險箱和工藝完美的保險箱是有著相當大的差別。

records.english: They may not be as flashy as a powerful weapon or armour item, but flasks in Path of Exile will literally mean the difference between life and death.
records.zhTW: 它們不像武器或護甲裝備一樣強大，但藥劑在流亡黯道對生與死也佔了很重要的一部分。

records.english:
Flasks in Path of Exile are not consumable items. Unlike Scrolls of Wisdom, when you use a Flask, it does not vanish. Instead, it simply consumes a number of flask charges based on the flask you're using, and, once empty, must be refilled before it can be used again. Flasks can come in normal, magic or unique rarity, but not rare. 

Usually, flasks refill as you slay monsters. This means as long as you're successfully engaging in combat, you should always have a flask or two available for use. But if you get into a spot of trouble and empty your flasks, you'll either have to carefully slay enough monsters to refill them or return to Town. 

Your flasks also refill when you return to Town, so jumping into a portal is a valid strategy when you're running low on flask charges. Some flasks, such as those with the 'Surgeon's' prefix, can be refilled based on other conditions.
records.zhTW:
流亡黯道的藥劑並不是消耗品。不像知識卷軸，當你使用藥劑的時候不會消失，只會消耗藥劑的充能數量，一旦藥劑空了，就必須要重新充能藥劑後才可以再次使用。藥劑的稀有度有一般、魔法或傳奇，不包含稀有。

通常可以透過擊殺怪物充能藥劑。這表示只要流亡者持續的進行戰鬥，你應該都會有一或兩瓶的藥劑可以使用。但若你陷入危機且你的藥劑已經空了，你就必須要小心的清怪讓藥劑重新充能，或是回到城鎮。

你的藥劑在你回到城鎮後也會完成充能，所以當你的藥劑充能不夠時，逃進傳送門中也是種有效的策略。有些藥劑，像是有「外科醫生的」的前綴，在其他情況下也可以充能藥劑。

records.english:
Other magic mods can enhance the amount of life or mana a [Flask] restores, or the duration it lasts, or the number of times it can be used. Some also provide extra utilities, such as removing curses or [Ailments]. 

Carefully selecting your flasks and which mods they have is just as important as selecting which weapon to wield or passive skills to take. If ever you are struggling to survive, take a look at your flasks and see if improvements can be made. They are often a cheap and effective place to start solving character build problems.
records.zhTW:
其他魔法詞綴可強化[Flask|藥劑]的生命或魔力回復量、持續時間，或是可使用次數。其中一些可提供額外功用，像是移除詛咒或[Ailments|異常狀態]。

慎選你的藥劑以及帶有的詞綴，其重要性並不亞於挑選你的武器或天賦。如果你常常死亡，不妨留意一下你的藥劑，看看有沒有能提升的地方。在解決角色流派問題上，藥劑往往是個經濟實惠的選擇。

records.english: Carefully consider your flask modifiers. They can make all the difference.
records.zhTW: 謹慎選擇你的藥劑詞綴。它們可以使一切都變的不一樣。

records.english: It's helpful to have a mix of different flasks for different situations.
records.zhTW: 多種藥劑組合對各種情況是很有幫助的。

records.english: Flasks are friends! Don't be afraid to use them often.
records.zhTW: 藥劑是你的好夥伴！不要害怕使用它們。

records.english:
You may encounter large blue crystals throughout the world that have imprisoned several monsters. By activating the central crystal you can free the monster within, but beware: that monster has been empowered by an Essence, and will be significantly tougher to kill than usual. If you manage to defeat the monster within, you can claim the essence for yourself. 

Essences are a special type of currency item that can typically only be found by defeating these trapped monsters. Unlike ordinary currency items, Essences have semi-predictable outcomes -- they will always guarantee that a certain mod appears.
records.zhTW:
在流亡黯道冒險時你可能會遇到被巨大藍色水晶禁錮的怪物。啟動中心的水晶，你將會釋放被禁錮其中的怪物，但請注意：這些怪物都是被精髓強化過的，且會比一般怪物還要難擊殺。若你成攻擊殺這些精髓怪物，你可以取得怪物的精髓。

精髓是個特別的通貨種類，且只可以在擊敗精髓怪物後取得。不像其他一般通貨，精髓有著半預期性的工藝結果，精髓可以保證出現某些特定的詞綴。

records.english: Essences are particularly useful early on, or when your character needs a certain mod, such as fire resistance. When the usefulness of low-level essences drops away, you can upgrade them by selling three identical essences to a vendor. Doing so will grant you one similar, but more effective, essence.
records.zhTW: 精髓在早期或是你的角色需要某種詞綴時是相當有用的，像是火焰抗性。當低階的精髓掉落時，你可以將三個相同的精髓販賣給商人來提升精髓的等級。你會獲得類似且更有效用的精髓。

records.english: Monsters who carry essences are much more difficult than ordinary monsters. Be careful!

records.english:
Once you have reached Act 7, you may encounter Alva Valai. Alva is trying to find the location of the lost treasure temple of Atzoatl using ancient Waystones that begin appearing from the Causeway onwards. With her help, you will travel back in time two thousand years, to the Temple of Atzoatl during its construction. During this time, you can help influence the temple's construction, so that when you eventually find it, it is filled with glorious treasure.

You'll only have a limited amount of time during this visit to influence the layout of Atzoatl in the present day, but this time can be extended by slaying its inhabitants. Enemies will not drop loot during your Incursions, but once the timer runs out, you'll be returned to the present-day and showered with loot based on how well you did.

There are two primary objectives to pursue during your incursion: Architects and Altars of Passage.
records.zhTW:
你到達第 7 章後會遇到艾瓦弗萊。艾瓦正試圖找到失落秘寶阿茲瓦特神廟的位置。在她的幫助下，你將回到兩千年前，阿茲瓦特神廟還在建造的時期。在此期間，你可以影響神廟的建設，所以當你找到神廟的時候，裡面將會富含豐富的寶藏。

你只能在有限的時間造訪過去，來影響阿茲瓦特現今的佈局，但可以透過擊殺當地的居民來延長待在過去的時間。在你穿越期間的敵人都不會掉落戰利品，但當時間結束，你將會被傳送回到現今，並且會依據你的表現掉落戰利品。

在穿越期間有兩個主要目標：建造者和通道之壇。

records.english:
Each chamber in Atzoatl has several walls which could potentially allow it to connect to another chamber. Some of these may already be connected, but many won't. If, during your Incursion, an enemy drops a Stone of Passage, you can pick it up and place it in an Altar of Passage, and it will connect the chamber you are in to an adjacent one.

This is important, because when you visit the Temple of Atzoatl during the present day, you may only be able to reach the chambers you managed to connect in the past!
records.zhTW:
每個在阿茲瓦特內的房間都有幾面牆，可能可以與其他房間連通。有些可能是已經連結了，但仍有許多是未連結的狀態。若在你穿越的期間，敵人掉落連通之石，你可以撿起後放至於通道之壇上，這將會使房間相連。

這是相當重要的，因為當你造放現今的阿茲瓦特神廟，你只能到達你過去有設法連結的房間！

records.english:
Within each Incursion you can find two Vaal Architects. By slaying one, you will allow the other to escape and later develop that chamber in their own vision. If the surviving Architect had previously influenced the development of that room, that room will then be upgraded. If not, then that room will change to something within their realm of expertise.

For example, if you land in the Banquet Hall during an incursion and slay the Architect of Fortifications, allowing the Architect of Toxins to survive, the Banquet Hall will become the Poison Garden. If in a later Incursion you land in the Poison Garden and kill the Architect of Iron, again allowing the Architect of Toxins survive, it will be upgraded to the Cultivar Chamber.
records.zhTW:
每次的穿越你可以找到兩個瓦爾建造者。藉由擊殺其中一個，你將會使另一個脫逃，並使他將此房間發展為屬於他自己的版本。若存活的建造者原先就已經為該房間的發展者，這間房間將會升級。若不是，此房間將會改造為建造者的專業領域。

例如，若你在穿越降落於神廟宴會場並且擊殺壁壘建師，讓毒物建師存活，那麼神廟宴會場將會改造為監獄花園。若你於之後的穿越降落於監獄花園並擊殺鋼鐵建師，讓毒物建師在次存活，那監獄花園將會升級為培育秘室。

records.english:
The types and tiers of the rooms you help engineer through your Incursions ultimately form the Temple of Atzoatl in the present day. 

Each room has a different effect. Some are purely positive, while others may put you at significant risk for valuable rewards. By upgrading the Cultivar Chamber to the Toxic Grove, for example, you will fill the Temple of Atzoatl with dangerously poisonous plants, but you will also give yourself the opportunity to loot a unique item that can be found nowhere else.
records.zhTW:
你穿越期間所幫助工程師房間的種類和階級，最終會形成阿茲瓦特神廟現今的樣貌。

每個房間都有不同的效果。有些一定是有利的，但有些會讓你冒著風險而獲取寶物。舉例，將培育秘室升級至劇毒果園，你會使阿茲瓦特神廟布滿危險的有毒植物，但同時也讓你有機會找到其他地方無法找到的傳奇物品。

records.english:
Once you've performed enough Incursions, Alva will discover the location of Atzoatl, and will offer you the opportunity to go there. At long last, you can explore the temple you helped create, and loot it for all it's worth! 

After you've visited the temple in the present-day, the next time you find Alva in the world, she will offer you the opportunity to start your Incursions all over again, with a new temple layout and with new opportunities to maximise your rewards.
records.zhTW:
當你執行足夠的穿越任務後，艾瓦將會發現神廟的位置，並會提供你前往神廟的機會。最終，你可以探索你幫忙建造的神廟，並且奪取所有值錢的東西！

在你造訪完畢現今的神廟後，你下次再遇到艾瓦時，她會給你重新再來一次穿越任務的機會，有著全新的神廟佈局和全新的機會來最大化你的報酬。

records.english:
The Incursion league includes a set of 40 new challenges. When you complete 12 challenges, you will receive the Incursion Bandana. At 24, you will receive the Incursion Cloak. When you complete your 36th challenge, you will receive the Incursion Portal Effect. These cosmetic effects are only obtainable in this league. 

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Incursion Totem Pole decoration to display in your Hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Incursion challenges you completed during the league.
records.zhTW:

流亡者在完成19項挑戰成就時，接著每完成3項挑戰，可獲得穿越挑戰聯盟圖騰柱做為藏身處的裝飾。此圖騰將永久展示你在穿越挑戰聯盟中完成的挑戰數量。

records.english:
Once you have broken the seal in Highgate and gained access to the mines below, you will begin to encounter veins of Voltaxic Sulphite throughout the world. When you interact with these Voltaxic Sulphite veins, a character called Niko will appear to mine it out of the ground for you. 

Niko operates a mine that was previously abandoned by the Eternal Empire, and wants your help obtaining enough Sulphite to help illuminate the mine. Once you have some Sulphite, you can visit his mine. There are three points of interest at the mine: Niko himself, the Subterranean Chart, and the Generator.
records.zhTW:
一旦你打破在統治者之殿被封印，並前往下方的礦坑，你會在開始在鬼島各處找到魔暴硫酸的礦脈。當你點擊魔暴硫酸礦脈時，一個名叫尼科的人會幫你把它從地面中挖出。

尼科擁有一座礦脈，這礦脈先前被不朽帝國所遺棄，他希望你可以幫忙取得足夠的硫酸來照亮礦脈。一旦你有一些硫酸，你就可以拜訪他的礦脈。礦脈中有三個有趣的點：尼科、地下圖和製電機。

records.english:
To access the mine itself, you need to use the Subterranean Chart device and select the point within the mine you wish to visit. Once there, you will appear next to a mobile machine called Crawler, which is powered by the Voltaxic Sulphite you have collected throughout the world. Use Crawler to select which adjacent area within the mine you would like to explore, and it will start moving in that direction. Be aware that this consumes some amount of Voltaxic Sulphite. 

Along the way to your destination you will encounter monsters and other paths into the dark depths of the mine, and at your destination you may find a difficult fight! Be careful when straying too far from Crawler, because the darkness in this mine is no ordinary darkness!
records.zhTW:
為了前往礦脈，你需要使用地下圖設備並選擇其中你想拜訪的礦脈傳送點。一旦抵達那邊，你身旁會出現一台名為潛伏號的移動機器，它的動力為你在各處蒐集的魔暴硫酸。利用潛伏號選擇礦脈中你想探險相鄰的地區，它就會開始朝該方向移動。請留意，這會消耗一定數量的魔暴硫酸。

前往目的地的途中，沿途會遇到怪物並且其他道路會陷落於礦脈的黑暗中，在目的地你可能會遇到困難的對戰！因為在此礦脈中的黑暗非一般的黑暗，所以當離開潛伏號太遠時，請小心。

records.english:
The darkness in this mine obscures your vision, but it also deals you damage. The damage grows the longer you stay in the darkness, so while short visits into the darkness might be OK, you won't be able to stay in there for long periods.

The monsters within the mine are also empowered by the darkness, and will take massively reduced damage while they dwell within it. Some of the monsters will even use the darkness as a weapon, shutting down nearby lights. But don't worry, you can create some weapons of your own!
records.zhTW:
此礦脈中的黑暗會模糊你的視線，同時對你造成傷害。傷害隨著你待在黑暗中時間越久而越高，所以短暫待在黑暗中是沒問題的，你無法在該處停留太久。

礦脈中的怪物也被黑暗所增強，它們在黑暗處時會減免大量的傷害。有些怪物會使用黑暗作為武器，把附近的光線熄滅。但別擔心，你可以製造一些你自己的武器！

records.english:
With the Azurite you find in the mine you can craft and upgrade flares and dynamite.

Flares are portable light sources that can be thrown to specific locations and last for a short while. You won't get very far through the mine by just throwing flares -- you need Crawler's help for that -- but you can use them to explore areas near your pre-lit paths for valuable treasures.

Dynamite won't provide any light, but can be used to harm enemies and open up new paths. You'll encounter Fractured Walls throughout the mine that can be destroyed with a well-placed stick of dynamite.  Both of these items can be upgraded at the Generator, improving their effectiveness as well as the amount of each that you can carry. It's worth carrying a few on your character when you want to go treasure-hunting in the dark.
records.zhTW:
在礦脈中找到的碧藍礦可以用來工藝和升級閃光和炸藥。

閃光是可攜帶式光源，可以投擲至特定地區並持續一小段時間。你無法使用閃光就探險至礦脈很遠的地區 -- 你需要潛伏號的幫忙 -- 但你可以使用它們來探索先前已經被點亮的道路附近來找到稀有的寶藏。

炸藥不會提供任何光線，但可以用來傷害敵人和開啟新道路。你在礦脈會遇到壁痕之牆，炸藥位置放的好的話可以摧毀它。以上兩個物品都可以在製電機升級，改善他們的效能和你可以攜帶的數量。當你想要當暗影尋寶獵人時，攜帶一些在角色身上是相當划算的喔。

records.english:
While it's fun to explore and slay monsters, the main reason you'll want to explore the Azurite Mine is for the Resonators. Resonators are special crafting items with sockets. They act like Chaos Orbs and come in several different sizes. To use one, you need to find Fossils to socket into them.

It's the Fossils that set Resonators apart from their currency counterparts. Each Fossil socketed into a Resonator in some way influences what the outcome will be when that Resonator is used on an item. See below for an example.
records.zhTW:
當你在碧藍礦坑探險和殺怪得心應手時，你探索礦坑的主要因素就是鑄新儀了。鑄新儀為特殊的附插槽工藝物品。他們像點金石或混沌石的效果，並且有幾種不同大小。要使用的話，你必須找到化石鑲嵌進它。

這是化石，用來使鑄新儀與其他通貨與眾不同。每個化石鑲嵌入鑄新儀後，可以影響未來將鑄新儀使用於物品上的工藝結果。請看下方的範例。

records.english:
The Delve league includes a set of 40 new challenges. When you complete 12 challenges, you will receive the Canary pet. At 24, you will receive the Azurite Back Attachment. When you complete your 36th challenge, you will receive the Delve Portal. These cosmetic effects are only obtainable in this league. 

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Delve Totem Pole decoration to display in your Hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Delve challenges you completed during the league.

流亡者在完成19項挑戰成就時，接著每完成3項挑戰，可獲得掘獄挑戰聯盟圖騰柱做為藏身處的裝飾。此圖騰將永久展示你在掘獄挑戰聯盟中完成的挑戰數量。

records.english:
You may soon find strange patterns on your Atlas, such as swirling tentacles or glittering stars. These are indicators of whose influence those maps are under. Maps concealed by tentacles are under the influence of an entity called The Elder, while maps masked by stars are under the influence of The Shaper.

Each of these entities augment the maps they are influencing, either by adding extra monsters or making the boss fights more difficult. Completing a map that is influenced by one of these entities will remove the influence and may cause the other entity to influence that map instead.
records.zhTW:
你很快的就會在你的輿圖上發現奇怪的標記，像是捲動地觸手獲是閃爍的星星。這些標記表示誰正在控制這張地圖。被觸手環繞的地圖是被名為異界尊師的生物所控制，而被星光遍佈的地圖則是被塑界者控制。

這兩個生物控制的地圖都會被增強，不是有額外的怪物，就是會使頭目戰更加困難。完成被控制的地圖後，控制該地圖的勢力就會被移除，並且可能被另一個生物的勢力所控制。

records.english:
Completing other maps may also grow an entity's influence, though since the Shaper and Elder are at war with each other, you may not always get the outcome you want. If you want to grow The Elder's influence, your best bet may be to target Shaper-influenced areas or areas with no influence at all.

As The Elder's influence grows, you may find that several maps become inhabited by The Elder's guardians. Completing these maps involves tough boss encounters, but if you manage to do it, they may lead to The Elder itself.

Monsters in Shaper- or Elder-influenced maps can drop special versions of items that are also Elder- or Shaper-influenced. These items can roll special (and often very powerful) mods that are not ordinarily available.
records.zhTW:
完成其他地圖也有可能使他們的勢力成長，但因為異界尊師與塑界者雙方正在戰爭，你可能無法一直得到你想要的結果。如果你想要助長尊師的勢力，你最好瞄準塑界者所控制的地區或其他完全沒有被控制的地區。

隨著尊師勢力的成長，你可能會發現有些地圖會被尊師的守護者所佔據。要完成這些地圖會遭遇困難的頭目戰，但如果你完成這些地圖，他們會引導你至尊師。

塑界者或尊師控制地圖中的怪物可能會掉落特殊版本的物品，這些物品都是被塑界者或尊師所影響。這些物品可以出現特殊（有時相當強力）的詞綴，一般的物品是無法取得。

records.english:
When viewing your Atlas you may notice that some maps have large symbols around them. These are Atlas Objectives. Each objective signifies that opening and entering that map will guarantee an encounter with one of the masters.

Each symbol represents the presence of a specific master:
records.zhTW:
當查看你的輿圖時，你可能會注意到部份地圖被大圖示環繞。那就是輿圖日誌。每個日誌表是開啟進入地圖時，保證會有一個大師事件。

每個標示各別代表一個指定的大師：

records.english:
This special property is unique to your Atlas -- a party member can't benefit from the objectives on your Atlas.

The objectives are consumed as soon as you open the associated map. New objectives are guaranteed to appear once a day, but you also have a chance to generate a new objective whenever you complete a map.

New objectives select maps based on the tier of your last completed map, within two tiers. In other words, if you complete a tier 10 map, a new objective may appear on a tier 9, 10 or 11 map. The exceptions are tier 1 maps (which can cause objectives to appear on tiers 1, 2 or 3) and tier 16 maps (which can cause objectives to appear on tiers 14, 15, and 16). They favour maps you have previously completed but may appear on maps not yet revealed.

So if you're looking to find more Voltaxic Sulphite or just want to hunt beasts with Einhar, check your Atlas. You may have a friend waiting for you!
records.zhTW:
此特殊的屬性是你輿圖獨有的 -- 隊伍成員無法從你輿圖上的日誌獲得任何東西。

日誌在你開啟對應的地圖時就會被消耗。每日會刷新一次所有輿圖日誌，但當你完城地圖時，也有機會產生新的日誌。

新日誌會根據你最後完成的地圖來選擇，且在加減 1 階級。換句話說，若你完成階級 10 的地圖，新的日誌可能會出現在階級 9、10、11 的地圖。階級 1 (日誌會出現在階級 1、2、3)和階級 16 (日誌會出現在階級 14、15、16)為例外。偏向會出現在你先前已完成的地圖，但也有機會出現在尚未揭露的地圖。

若你當你急需魔暴硫酸，或只想和埃哈捉地鼠，檢查看看你的輿圖。或許會有個人在等著你喔！

records.english:
Once you have met Jun Ortoi, you will begin encountering the Immortal Syndicate. If you manage to defeat an Immortal Syndicate member, they may drop a Veiled Item. Veiled Items are special rare items with Veiled Modifiers - modifiers masked by ancient magic that only Jun Ortoi can reveal.

When Jun unveils the modifier, you'll be presented with three different options for what that modifier will ultimately be. Not only are many of these modifiers very powerful, but unveiling them allows you to craft those modifiers using your Crafting Bench in your Hideout! So your choice is very important, even if you have no plans to use the item it appears on.
records.zhTW:
你遇到瓊恩歐塔時，你將會開始遭遇永生密教事件。若你擊敗永生密教的成員，他們有機會掉落隱匿道具。隱匿道具是有著隱匿詞綴的稀有道具 - 詞綴被古老魔法遮蔽，只有瓊恩歐塔可以揭露。

當瓊恩揭露詞綴，將會出現 3 個不同的詞綴選項來決定物品最終的詞綴。隱匿詞綴不僅有許多強大的詞綴，揭露詞綴的同時也可以讓你在藏身處使用工藝台來工藝這些詞綴。所以你的選擇就相當重要，即使出現的詞綴都不是你想使用在該物品上的。

records.english:
Veiled modifiers often have multiple tiers, however all tiers of a modifier will be unlocked for crafting when unveiled for the first time. Once you have unlocked a Veiled modifier for crafting, it will be available for all of the characters you create in that league. 

Additionally, some modifiers can only appear on items from specific Immortal Syndicate members. You can check whether a Veiled modifier is from a certain member before you unveil it by looking at the advanced modifier description (enabled in the Options menu).

One final thing to consider: even if you have unlocked all the Veiled modifiers you want, Veiled items still have value -- to other players! Some players may pay a premium for items that have not yet been unveiled, so that they can rapidly learn the recipes! Consider selling Veiled items to other players!
records.zhTW:
隱匿詞綴通常都會有許多階級，且只能透過揭露相同的詞綴來獲得更高階的詞綴，部分詞綴只會出現在特殊永生密教成員掉落的物品上。你可以在揭露隱匿詞綴前，使用進階詞綴敘述(可以在設定中開啟)可以確認詞綴是來自哪位密教成員。

一旦你解鎖隱匿詞綴，它就可以被你所有於該聯盟的角色所工藝。隱匿詞綴被視為工藝詞綴，即使你沒有工藝過它們。這表示，在一般情況下，你將無法工藝額外的詞綴在你已揭露的道具上。

最後一件事：即使你已經解鎖所有你想要的隱匿詞綴，隱匿道具對於其他玩家仍相當有價值。有些玩家可能會支付高額價錢來購買尚未揭露過的道具，來快速習得配方！可以考慮將物品販賣給其他玩家！

Each sample must be of a different body part. The resulting enemy will use skills from each creature used to create it. With a full meter and a Map Boss sample, the defeated Metamorph will also drop a special sample that can be traded or used in Tane's Laboratory.
records.zhTW:
在此區域搜集你所擊殺怪物的樣本。合成五個不同的樣本來創造強大的敵人。

每個樣本必須都為身體的不同部位。合成出的怪物將會使用每個創造他生物的技能。有著全計量和地圖頭目樣本，被擊敗的鍊魔會掉落特殊的樣本，可以在塔恩的煉金室交易或使用。

records.english:
Trinity:
Affinity is a buff granted by the Trinity skill. There are three types of Affinity: Fire, Cold and Lightning. You can have a maximum of 100 of each type of Affinity.

You lose 10 Affinity per second of specific types if you haven't gained Affinity of that type in the past 8 seconds.
records.zhTW:
三位一體：
親和是由三位一體技能給予的增益效果。親和分為三種類型：火焰、冰冷與閃電。每種類型的親和最多可擁有 100 點。

如果你在過去 8 秒內沒有獲得某種類型的親和，則每秒會失去 10 點該類型的親和。

records.english: Refers to the Delirium league. Can be randomly encountered in areas as a "mirror" you walk through or applied to Maps with special currency orbs. Delirium encounters coat the area in a fog, straying deeper into the fog increases the strength of monsters but offers valuable rewards.
records.zhTW: 關於譫妄聯盟。在區域中可以隨機遇到「鏡子」穿越過去或使用特殊通貨來使地圖套用效果。譫妄事件籠罩在迷霧中，深入迷霧會增加怪物的力量，但也會提供珍貴的獎勵。

records.english: Refers to the Legion league. Legion monoliths can be randomly encountered and, when interacted with, reveal two opposing armies frozen in time. Break them out of their stasis within the given time to fight them in their true forms or unlock rare chests.
records.zhTW: 關於戰亂聯盟。玩家會可以隨機遇到戰亂石陣，點擊後會出現兩個被時間凍結的敵對軍隊。在指定時間內打破他們的停滯狀態，他們將轉化真實形態與他們戰鬥，並解鎖稀有寶箱。

records.english: Introduced in the Heist league. Gathering a team of Rogues, plan and execute heists by infiltrating various facilities and looting what you can without triggering the alarm, then escaping before the guards can stop you.
records.zhTW: 關於劫盜聯盟。召集一群盜賊，通過潛入各種設施並在不觸發警報的情況下，盡可能掠奪更多的東西，在守衛逮到你前逃跑。

records.english: Refers to the Harvest league, can be encountered in map areas as a blue portal. Inside the portal are sets of two seed plots to choose from, each offering different monsters to fight and rewards. These rewards offer very powerful crafting methods in limited quantities, not found anywhere else in Wraeclast.
records.zhTW: 關於豐收聯盟。可以在地圖中遇到藍色的傳送門。 門內有兩組可供選擇的種子地塊，每個地塊都提供不同的怪物進行戰鬥和獎勵。 這些獎勵提供數量有限的非常強大的工藝方法，在瓦爾克拉斯的其他地方都無法發現。

records.english: Refers to the interface used during the mapping endgame. Used to track map completion progress, level up or modify your maps and unlock boss encounters.
records.zhTW: 指的是在刷途終局期間可使用的面板。用於追蹤地圖完成進度、升級或調整地圖以及解鎖頭目事件。

records.english: Refers to the Ritual altars found in some areas. When activated, a small inescapable arena is formed. Kill waves of monsters and survive the Ritual's unique hazards to purchase rewards with Tribute gathered from the encounter. Multiple Ritual's can be found in an area and get progressively harder but offer stronger rewards as you complete them.
records.zhTW: 指在某些地區發現的祭祀神壇。啟動後，會形成一個無法逃脫的小型競技場。殺死一波又一波的怪物並在祭祀的獨特危險中倖存下來，用從事件中收集的貢禮購買獎勵。可以在一個區域中找到多個祭祀，並逐漸變得更難，但在你完成後會提供更強的獎勵。

records.english: Usually refers to the monster created during a Metamorph encounter. Once you've collected all five types of organs in a map you can use Tane's vat to customize and spawn your very own monster to kill! Rewards and difficulty are decided by the quality of organs used so choose carefully.
records.zhTW: 通常是指在鍊魔事件中創造的怪物。 一旦你在地圖中收集所有五種類型的器官，你就可以使用塔恩的器具客製化生成你的怪物來殺死！獎勵和難度取決於使用器官的質量，因此請謹慎選擇。

records.english: Refers to the tower-defense encounters found in maps, Sister Cassia can be found next to yellow fungal growths which are used to start the encounter. Trails of roots will emerge with portals housing monsters at the ends. Building towers at specific points along the trail, and your own power, you must stop the monsters from reaching the growth in the center.
records.zhTW: 指的是在地圖中發現的塔防事件，卡西亞修女可以在事件初始地的黃色真菌旁邊找到。樹根的軌跡將出現，終端有出現怪物的傳送門。在沿途的特定點建造禦防塔，並靠自己的力量，你必須阻止怪物到達中心點。

records.english: Refers to the missions associated with the Veiled Master, Jun Ortoi. Neutralize and interrogate members of the Immortal Syndicate for loot and to build intelligence towards tracking down the mastermind of the group.
records.zhTW: 指與幻隱大師瓊恩的相關任務。為了戰利品殺死和審問永生密教成員，並蒐集情報以追蹤該組織的幕後首領。

records.english:
Choose an Archnemesis Modifier you have collected and Empower this petrified monster with its properties. If you can defeat this foe, you will receive the rewards bestowed by the Modifier.

Subsequent petrified monsters in this area will inherit all Modifiers that have been applied so far in this area, compounding their difficulty and rewards.

Certain Modifiers can be combined together in Recipes, yielding exclusive Modifiers that can't be found from monsters. Many of these exclusive recipe Modifiers can then be combined together to form further recipes.

Modifiers you have that can currently be used in a Recipe are indicated with borders. The more intense the border, the more complex the recipe is.

Each type of Modifier can only be applied once per area.
records.zhTW:
選擇 1 個你蒐集的宿敵詞綴並賦予它的屬性至此石化怪物。若你能擊敗此敵人，你將獲得詞綴給予的獎勵。

此地區後續的石化怪物會繼承全部先前套用的詞綴，來增強他們的難度和獎勵。

特定詞綴可以合成，產生無法在其他怪物身上發現的限定詞綴。這些限定詞綴可以再進一步合成出其他的詞綴。

你當前擁有的詞綴可用來當作配方會用邊框標示。邊框越密集，配方就越複雜。

在每個區域中，每種詞綴只能套用一次。

records.english:
Place and remove Filaments on the Sentinel Controller to control the flow of power between Runic Nodes. You can change your Controller layout as much as you want without any cost.

As you kill enemies empowered by your Sentinels, you gain progress towards unlocking additional power units, which will automatically flow through the Filaments you have placed.

Power additional Sentinel Slots to gain access to multiple Sentinels per area. You must have at least one Sentinel Slot powered at all times.

records.english:
<bigger>{<title>{Trial of the Sekhemas}}
The Trial of the Sekhemas will pit you against ancient tests. Those that endure these tests can reap great rewards. The Trials require a Barya to participate.

Completing these trials can earn [AscendancyPoints|Ascendancy Skill Points].

Damage you take in the Trial impacts your [Honour]. Lost Honour persists between trials.
Losing all your Honour fails the Trial. This is not considered dying for your character.

<bigger>{<title>{Relics}}
Relics influence various aspects of the Trial to make it easier. Your Relics persist between Trials.
<yellow>{Selected Relics cannot be changed while you have an active Trial.}

Relics have varying dimensions, so arrange them carefully to maximise your benefits.

You can unlock more Relic slots by killing bosses deeper into the Trials.

Spare Relics can be stored in the Relic Locker or any of your personal stash tabs.
records.zhTW:
<bigger>{<title>{絲克瑪的試煉}}

絲克瑪的試煉會讓你進行一場遠古的考驗。通過這些試煉的人將可獲得豐厚的獎勵。該試煉需要一枚巨靈之幣才能進行。



完成這些試煉可獲得[AscendancyPoints|昇華天賦點數]。



在試煉中受到傷害會影響你的[Honour|榮譽]。失去的榮譽會在試煉之間保留下來。

失去所有榮譽時，試煉便會失敗。但你的角色不會死亡。



<bigger>{<title>{聖物}}

聖物將會影響試煉的各個要素，使其變簡單。你的聖物在不同試煉之間會被保留下來。

<yellow>{當你有正在進行中的試煉時，所選的聖物便無法更換。}



聖物有各種面向，所以請謹慎使用來最大化你的利益。



你可以擊殺試煉中的頭目來解鎖更多聖物欄位。



多餘的聖物可以存放在聖物鎖櫃或你的倉庫頁中。

records.english:
<valuedefault>{Energy Shield}
Protects your Life by taking damage instead. Rapidly [ESRecharge|Recharges] if you don't lose Energy Shield for a short time.
[Chaos] damage removes twice as much Energy Shield.
Damage from [Bleeding] and [Poison] bypasses Energy Shield to remove Life directly.

<valuedefault>{能量護盾}
代為承受傷害來避免生命的損失。若你在短時間內未失去能量護盾，它將會快速[ESRecharge|充能]。
[Chaos|混沌]傷害會移除兩倍的能量護盾量。
[Bleeding|流血]和[Poison|中毒]的傷害會無視能量護盾，並直接移除生命。

records.english:

<valuedefault>{精魂保留}

records.english:
<valuedefault>{Estimated Armour Mitigation}
[Armour] reduces the [Physical|Physical Damage] you take from both [Attack|Attacks] and [Spell|Spells] (but provides no benefit against other [DamageTypes|Damage Types]).

Exact Damage Reduction depends on the damage dealt, but cannot be higher than 90%.
records.zhTW:
<valuedefault>{預期護甲傷害減輕}
[Armour|護甲]降低你從 [Attack|攻擊]和[Spell|法術]受到的[Physical|物理傷害]（對於其他[DamageTypes|傷害類型]並無效益）。

實際傷害減免取決於造成的傷害量，但不可高於 90%。

records.english:
<valuedefault>{Estimated Evasion Chance}
Evasion grants a chance to avoid enemy [Strike|Strikes] or [Projectile|Projectiles]. 

Exact chance of success also depends on the attacker's [Accuracy].
records.zhTW:
<valuedefault>{預期閃避率}
閃避值賦予一定機率閃躲敵人[Strike|打擊]或[Projectile|投射物]。

實際機率取決於攻擊者的[Accuracy|命中]值。

records.english:
<valuedefault>{Block Chance}
Chance to [Block] incoming [Strike|Strikes] and [Projectile|Projectiles], causing them to deal no damage. 

Some larger and more dangerous enemy [Strike|Strikes] cannot be [Block|Blocked].
records.zhTW:
<valuedefault>{格檔機率}
擊中你的[Strike|打擊]和[Projectile|投射物]受[Block|格擋]的機率，被格檔時不會造成傷害。

部分體型較大且更具威脅性的敵人對你[Strike|打擊]無法被[Block|格擋]。

records.english:
<valuedefault>{Suppression Chance}
Chance to [Suppress] a Spell that hits you, causing it to deal 50% less Damage. 

Does not apply to Attacks.

<valuedefault>{壓抑機率}
擊中你的法術受[壓抑]的機率。壓抑使其造成的傷害減少 50%。 

壓抑不適用於攻擊。

records.english:

擊中你的攻擊受[反彈]的機率。反彈會使其造成的傷害減少 50%。

<valuedefault>{To place an order ensure you have chosen items that you want to trade, have a valid Real Ratio with values between 1 - 65000, and have enough gold and items.

Items cannot be claimed unless your order is completed or closed. Closing your order by pressing X will not refund your gold.

Market orders can only ever trade at or above your chosen ratio. If your order is unable to be completed through finding better deals, you will receive a gold refund for the uncompleted part of your order along with any unspent currency. You will never receive more than your "I Want" amount, but you may pay less than your "I Have" amount.

Hovering the Market Ratio shows more information about available trades on the market. Holding} Alt <valuedefault>{while hovering the Market Ratio also shows information about competing trades on the market.

If your chosen ratio is} dimmed <valuedefault>{it indicates that your order will not match with existing orders on the market. Your order will only complete if other traders choose to trade at your ratio.}

records.english:
<bigger>{<title>{Ultimatum}}
Offer an Inscribed Ultimatum to partake in the Trialmaster's Trials.

Completing these trials can earn [AscendancyPoints|Ascendancy Skill Points].

At each trial you will earn a reward, but also have to select a modifier to make the trials more difficult.

If you die within the trials you cannot return and forfeit all earned rewards.
records.zhTW:
<bigger>{<title>{最後通牒}}

獻上一個最後通牒雕刻以參加試煉大師的試煉。

你在每個試煉都會獲得獎勵，但也需要選擇一個詞綴來讓試煉變得更難。

只有完成最終試煉後才可以拿取獎勵。

如果你在試煉中死亡，你將無法返回並會失去所有已獲得的獎勵。

records.english:
<default>{Energise Beacons throughout Wraeclast to collect [IncursionCrystal|Energised Crystals] to access Atziri's Temple.
Once 6 Energised Crystals have been collected interacting with the Temple Console will consume them and offer a random selection of 6 rooms to place, and allow entry into the Temple.
Rooms can be placed by selecting them and placing next to paths or other rooms they upgrade.

Completing the temple will cause minor [IncursionDestabilization|Destabilisation] when you leave, destroying a small portion of your rooms or paths.
Killing the Architect or Atziri will cause greater destabilization of the temple, destroying a larger portion of your rooms or paths.}

<white>{Restricted Rooms
}<default>{After defeating the Architect you'll gain access to Xipocado's Console in his chamber allowing you to place Restricted Rooms. 
Completing a Restricted Room will cause it to destabilise. 
One of these rooms is the Royal Access Chamber which is required to access Atziri, Queen of the Vaal.}

<white>{Medallions
}<default>{After defeating the Architect for the first time, medallions may be found in the temple from the Vaal with royal blood.
These provide powerful bonuses. 
Board-related medallions are used on appropriate rooms. 
Each room can only be affected by 1 medallion of each type.}
records.zhTW:
<default>{在整個瓦爾克拉斯充能烽塔以收集[IncursionCrystal|充能水晶]，以進入阿茲里的神廟。
當收集到6個[IncursionCrystal|充能水晶]後，與神廟主控台互動會消耗它們，並提供6個隨機房間供你放置，並允許你進入神廟。
房間可以透果選擇它們以放置在道路旁或其可升級的房間旁。
完成神廟後，當你離開時會造成神廟輕微的 [IncursionDestabilization|不穩定]，摧毀你的一小部分房間或道路。
擊殺建築師或阿茲里會造成更嚴重的不穩定，摧毀更多的房間或道路。}

<white>{Reward Rooms
}<default>{擊敗建築師後，你將可在其房間中使用賽匹卡托的神廟主控台放置獎勵房間。
完成一個獎勵房間會使其不穩定。
其中一個房間為皇家通道室，是通往瓦爾女王．阿茲里的必經之路。}

<white>{Medallions
}<default>{首次擊敗建築師後，神廟中具有皇族血統的瓦爾人可能會掉落聖徽。
它們提供強大的加成與永久的進度獎勵。
與主控台相關的聖徽必須用在對應的房間上。每個房間只能受到 1 個聖徽的影響。}

records.english:
Atlas Masters lend you their power in any area throughout the endgame. 

Masters can be unlocked and leveled up by finding them in the world and completing their quests. 

Each level unlocks an additional row of options and one point to allocate. Each option requires one point to allocate and any combination of options may be selected.

Master selection and points allocation can be changed freely prior to opening an area to apply a different master or bonus to future areas.
records.zhTW:
輿圖大師會在整個遊戲後期的任何區域賦予你力量。

在世界中找到大師並完成他們的任務，即可解鎖並提升大師等級。

每次升級將解鎖額外一排的選項，以及一點可配置的點數。每個選項需要消耗一點點數來配置，你可以自由選擇任何選項組合。

在開啟區域之前，你可以自由更改大師選擇與點數配置，將不同的大師或加成效果套用至未來的區域。

records.english:
<valuedefault>{The Verisium Anvil allows you to spend Verisium to Runeforge your equipment. 

Any non-[Rarity|Unique] Armour can be Runeforged, causing it to grant [Ward|Runic Ward]. After level 54, Armours convert a portion of its [Armour], [Evasion] or [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] into [Ward|Runic Ward]. The exact proportions differ between different Base Types. 

[Rarity|Unique] Weapons and Armours can also be Runeforged, upgrading their Base Type. Runeforging a Unique Item costs a Kalguuran Crest as well as Verisium.

Placing an applicable item into the left window displays a preview of the result in the right window, and the cost of Runeforging beneath.}

<valuedefault>{維里西姆鐵砧允許你花費維里西姆來符文鍛造你的裝備。

HUDHideoutInformationHoverText.english:
<currencyitem>{Edit Mode Controls:}
To move an object, drag it or press the arrow keys.
To rotate an object, drag between the two circles or press R/Shift+R.
To flip an object, select it and press F.
To change the variation of a decoration, use the mousewheel or press Page Up/Page Down.
To copy an object, right-click it then left-click to place a copy of it.
To reclaim an object, select it and press Delete.
<b>{When finished, click the Edit button}
HUDHideoutInformationHoverText.zhTW:
<currencyitem>{編輯模式操作：}
欲移動一個物品，請拖曳它或是使用方向鍵來操作。
欲旋轉一個物品，請點擊外圈與內圈之間並拖曳選擇旋轉角度，或是按下 R / Shift + R。
欲翻轉一個物品，請選擇它並按下 F。
欲改變一個物品呈現方式，滾動滑鼠滾輪或是按下 Page Up / Page Down。
欲複製一個物品，請右鍵點擊它，然後左鍵點擊以放置一個複製品。
欲回收一個物品，請點擊它並按下 Delete。
<b>{編輯結束時，請點擊「編輯」按鈕}

TutorialPanelSkillGemTitle.zhTW: 技能寶石 I：基礎知識

TutorialPanelSkillGemContent1.english:
In Path of Exile, all of your skills (other than your default attack) come from items called 'skill gems'. Skill gems must be socketed into your equipped weapons and armour in order for you to be able to use the skill they grant. It doesn't matter which item the gem is socketed into, but the socket has to match the colour of the gem. In other words, red skill gems can go in red sockets, and can't go in blue or green sockets.

Support gems work very similarly to skill gems, except they don't grant you a skill by themselves. Instead, support gems can augment the skill gems they are linked to. Not all skill and support gems work together; You can't use a 'Melee Physical Damage Support' with a spell, for example.
TutorialPanelSkillGemContent1.zhTW:
在流亡黯道中，你的所有技能(除了普通攻擊)都是來自於「技能寶石」。要使用技能的能力，一定要將技能寶石鑲嵌於武器和裝備的插槽中。技能寶石無論插在哪個物品上都可以發揮效果，但一定要鑲嵌於同樣顏色的插槽中。舉例：紅色的技能寶石只能鑲嵌於紅色的插槽中，無法鑲嵌於藍色或綠色的插槽。

輔助寶石與技能寶石使用方法很相似，但它們無法直接給與你輔助效果。輔助寶石可以增強與他相連的技能寶石。並不是所有技能都可以和輔助寶石發揮效果。舉例：近戰物理傷害輔助與法術技能無法發揮效果。

TutorialPanelSkillGemContent2.english:
For a support gem to properly augment a skill gem, both the skill and support gems must be socketed in linked sockets. If they aren't linked, the support will have no effect.

You can tell whether or not your support gem is affecting your skill gem by looking at the on-screen skill icon. Properly linked support gems add a little letter to the skill icon on the user interface. Most support gems also change the mana cost of the skills they're supporting.
TutorialPanelSkillGemContent2.zhTW:
要讓輔助寶石增強技能寶石，兩者寶石插槽必須要相連。若插槽沒有相連，則輔助寶石將無法發揮效果。

你可以透過技能快捷鍵的視窗中確認輔助寶石是否有發揮效果。有效的輔助寶石會於技能圖示中顯示一個小字母。大多數的輔助寶石都會增加輔助技能的魔力消耗。

TutorialPanelSkillGemContent3.english: You can add or remove your skill and support gems at any time, so don't be afraid to experiment with strange gem combinations.
TutorialPanelSkillGemContent3.zhTW: 你可以在任何時候增加或移除技能和輔助寶石，所以不要害怕嘗試各種寶石組合唷。

TutorialPanelSupportGemTitle.english: Skill Gems II: Requirements and Restrictions
TutorialPanelSupportGemTitle.zhTW: 技能寶石 II：需求與限制

TutorialPanelSupportGemContent1.english: Support and skill gems, like other items, have level and attribute requirements. Unlike other items, gems can level up, and when a gem levels up, its level and attribute requirements can change. If you level a gem past the point that you can use it, or if your attributes change and disable a gem, the entire item the gem is socketed in will also be disabled. That means it's worth checking whether or not you should level up gems that don't require your primary attributes. Sometimes it's better not to level up a gem!
TutorialPanelSupportGemContent1.zhTW: 輔助和技能寶石和其他物品一樣，有等級和能力的需求。但與其他物品不同的是，寶石可以升等，當寶石升等後，它的等級和能力需求都會改變。如果你將寶石升級至你無法使用的等級，或是你的能力改變導致寶石失效，則你鑲嵌寶石的物品將會失去能力。這表示在升級寶石前，務必確認自己的等級和能力是否符合寶石升級後的需求。所以有時候最好別升級寶石呀!

TutorialPanelSupportGemContent2.english: You may find that you want to use the same support gem for multiple skills. Simply socket that support in the same item as the skills you wish to support and make sure they are all linked. The support gem doesn't have to be adjacent to the skill gems you want to support; they just have to all be part of the same group of linked sockets. You may also find that you want the same skill to be supported by multiple support gems. The requirements for this are the same.
TutorialPanelSupportGemContent2.zhTW: 你可能會發現你想要使用相同的輔助寶石輔助許多技能。你可以將你想要輔助的技能都鑲嵌於輔助技能所在的物品中，但請確認物品插槽都是相連。輔助的技能不用與輔助寶石相鄰一樣可以獲得輔助寶石的效果。你可能也會發現你的技能想要被多個輔助寶石輔助，則使用的方使與上述相同。

TutorialPanelSupportGemContent3.english: Some support gems will significantly change the way the supported skills behave. A spell supported by the 'Spell Totem' support will now summon a totem to cast the spell for you, and you won't be able to cast the spell yourself. The same is true for the 'Trap' support and the two Mine supports, 'High-Impact Mine' and 'Blastchain Mine.'
TutorialPanelSupportGemContent3.zhTW: 有些輔助寶石會改變被輔助技能的型式。法術技能被「法術圖騰」輔助時，則將會召喚一個圖騰施放此法術，而你無法再使用此法術。同樣的道理可以套用在陷阱與連鎖爆破地雷、高能地雷輔助。

TutorialPanelSupportGemContent4.english: Some support gems can be used to trigger a skill automatically. The 'Cast on Critical Strike Support' gem casts the spells it is supporting whenever you get a critical strike with an attack it is also supporting. Any spell supported this way can only be triggered and can no longer be cast manually, similar to how the Spell Totem Support works. Skills being supported by multiple trigger gems won't work at all. Keep this in mind when deciding which skills and supports you want to use.
TutorialPanelSupportGemContent4.zhTW: 有些輔助寶石可以自動觸發技能。「暴擊時施放輔助」寶石將會在你攻擊暴擊時，自動施放輔助的技能。當技能被此類型寶石輔助時，只能被觸發無法在手動施放，就像是法術圖騰一樣。請謹記在心此技能串法喔。

TutorialPanelSupportGemCaption1.english: A skill gem's features can change when it levels up, including the requirements to use it.
TutorialPanelSupportGemCaption1.zhTW: 某些技能寶石隨著等級提升，功能將會改變，當然也包括使用需求。

TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent1.english:
Your character build is primarily composed of the items the character is wearing, the skill and support gems that are socketed within those items, and the passive skills you have chosen from the passive skill tree. Because the passive skill tree lays the groundwork for your items and gems, the passive skill tree is arguably the core of every character build. 

Whenever you level up, and upon completing certain quests, you'll get a passive skill point. Each point can be allocated on the passive skill tree to gain the benefits of the passive skill (often referred to as a 'passive') it is spent on.

You can only allocate points on passives that are connected to your other allocated passives. There are far, far more passive skills on the tree than you can ever allocate, so you need to think carefully about what you want to choose. It is often worth planning ahead.

There are three types of passive skill:
TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent1.zhTW:
你的角色流派主要是由你角色所穿的裝備、使用的技能和輔助寶石和你所選擇的天賦組成。天賦樹的鋪成會為你的裝備和寶石作為基礎，所以天賦樹是每個角色流派的核心。

當你升等或是完成某些任務時，你都可以獲得一點天賦點。每個天賦點都可以從天賦樹中獲得你所配置天賦的效果。

你只能配置與先前已配置過的天賦點相鄰的天賦。天賦樹中有相當多的天賦，多到你無法全部都配置，所以每一步路都要想清楚。最好先前就做好規劃。

天賦一共有三種類型：

TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent2.english: Many clusters on the passive tree have 'Masteries' at their centres which signify the type of passives that cluster grants. Allocating any Notable in a cluster with a Mastery grants access to the 'Mastery passive.' Mastery passives provide a selection of one of many special stats related to the Mastery theme (e.g. Fire or Bow). Like regular passives, Masteries require a passive point to allocate. Mastery passives are shared across the tree, so Fire Masteries everywhere give the same selection of special stats. Special stats cannot be allocated more than once.
TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent2.zhTW: 許多聚在一起的天賦中間帶有圖樣，意味著那區天賦的功能。如果你正找尋類似功能的天賦，可以利用圖示來分辨。

TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent3.english:
The passive skill tree also contains jewel sockets. An allocated jewel socket can hold a jewel, but won't grant any sort of benefit by itself. Jewels cannot interact with Masteries.

The edges of the passive skill tree are also home to Large jewel sockets, these can hold Cluster jewels as well as regular jewels.
TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent3.zhTW:
天賦樹中包含了珠寶插槽。配置到珠寶插槽時，可以裝備一個珠寶，但裝備珠寶前不會獲得任何效果。珠寶不會與專精互動。

天賦樹邊緣同時也是巨型珠寶插槽的所在，這些插槽可以放置星團珠寶或一般珠寶。

TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent4.english:
The tree is shared by all of the character classes, but each class begins in a different location. Learning what is near each starting location will help you plan out future characters.

You can undo your choices with the passive refund points you get from certain quests and from using Orbs of Regret. You can only undo a single point per refund point, so if you plan on making changes later, make sure you can afford to do so.
TutorialPanelPassiveSkillTreeContent4.zhTW:
天賦樹與所有職業共用，但每個職業的起始點位置都不相同。知道每個起始點附近的天賦有助於你之後角色的養成。

你可以使用天賦重置點回收已配置的天賦，每點天賦重置點只能收回一點天賦，所以在使用前請先確認是否有足夠的重置點喔。(天賦重置點可透過某些任務、後悔石取得或於商城購買)

TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent1.english: Items, monsters, strongboxes, and later even maps, can all have different rarities. Something's rarity determines what properties it has. Generally, something that is 'magic' is stronger than something that is 'normal', and something that is 'rare' is stronger than something that is 'magic'. This is achieved through random modifiers, or 'mods'.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent1.zhTW: 物品、怪物、寶顯相和地圖都可以有不同的稀有度。物品的稀有度決定它有多少效能。一般來說，「魔法物品」會比「普通物品」還強。「稀有物品」則會比「魔法物品」強。這是因為物品上的隨機「詞綴」。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent2.english: Rarity determines how many mods something can have. Magic rarity typically imbues something with either one or two mods, while most rares can get up to six.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent2.zhTW: 稀有度決定了物品可以有多少詞綴。魔法物品通常只能獲得1至2個詞綴，而稀有物品至多可以獲得6個詞綴。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent3.english:
If you're lucky, you may also find something that is of 'unique' rarity. Unique items always have the same mods, but those mods can be very different to the ones you find on magics and rares.

For example, this unique staff changes how your projectiles work:
TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent3.zhTW:
如果你夠幸運，你可以發現傳奇稀有度的物品。傳奇道具的詞綴都一樣，但這些詞綴都會與魔法和稀有道具非常不同。

舉例來說，傳奇物品可以改變你的投射物運作方式：

TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent4.english: Many unique items come with a downside, or provide specialised or conditional power without staple mods, such as elemental resistances or life. As a result, using many unique items doesn't necessarily always benefit you! Unique items also have their own special art, names and flavour text.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent4.zhTW: 許多傳奇物品都會有缺點，或是提供某方面強大的能力而不提供基礎詞綴，像是元素抗性或生命。所以並不是使用傳奇裝備就可以讓自己變強!傳奇物品都會有自己專屬的美術圖和寓意文。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent5.english: When people talk about 'uniques', they are usually referring to unique items, but there are also unique strongboxes, maps, and monsters throughout Path of Exile. Major content updates usually includes a number of new uniques.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersContent5.zhTW: 當大家提到「傳奇」時，多半是在講傳奇裝備，但流亡黯道中還有傳奇保險箱、傳奇地圖和傳奇怪物。大改版時通常都會有許多新的傳奇道具。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption1.english: Normal, Magic, Rare and Unique rarities are indicated by the colour of the name.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption1.zhTW: 普通、魔法、稀有和傳奇稀有度可以使用顏色區別。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption2.english: Each rarity tier has certain properties.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption2.zhTW: 每個稀有度都有某些效果。

TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption3.english: Some unique items provide utility at the cost of raw stats, or only fully work when certain conditions are met.
TutorialPanelRarityTiersCaption3.zhTW: 有些傳奇物品只能在原始狀態下才能發揮效果，或是達成某些條件。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsTit.english: Stats and Mods I: How Are They Calculated?
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsTit.zhTW: 數值和詞綴 I：如何計算？

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english: Your Path of Exile character is primarily built from a combination of passive skills, skill gems, and items. Both the passive tree and the items can seem overwhelming at first, so in this tutorial we will cover some of the basics.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW: 流亡黯道的角色流派，主要由天賦、技能寶石和裝備組合而成。天賦樹和裝備乍看之下可能會使人感到無助，故在此引導中，我們將介紹相關的基礎知識讓流亡者們了解。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english: The most important thing to know is how the passive tree interacts with your character. In general, passive skills affect all the relevant stats on your character, regardless of where they come from. We call these global modifiers.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW: 你一定要知道你的天賦對你的角色有什麼效果。一般來說，天賦影響到角色所有有關的能力，無論他的來源是什麼。我們可以稱呼這些為「全域詞綴」。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english: In the example above, we see that the 'increased maximum life' passives add together before they affect the character's life. Most passive skills, especially any that use the word 'increased', act this way.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW: 從上面的例子，增加最大生命的天賦會先全部加總，再增加到角色的生命。大多數的天賦都是這樣運作的。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english: Passives that specifically say they grant 'more' or 'less' of something are the exceptions to the above rule. These are applied after all of the increases, acting like multipliers. Unlike passives which increase something, passives which provide 'more' or 'less' of something never add together and instead each apply their multiplicative effect separately. These terms appear on Keystones in the passive skill tree, but are most commonly seen on support gems.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW: 如果天賦中有特別說明獲得「更多」或「更少」什麼的話，則不是用此規則。這將會於加總全部的增加詞綴後再套用此詞綴，像是加成的效果。不像增加詞綴會先加總，「更多」或「更少」詞綴會用相乘的方式計算。在輔助寶石上很常見此方式。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english: Item mods tend to come in two varieties: 'global mods', which act like the passive skills, and 'local mods', which affect the item itself. Compare the weapons below, and note that the magic weapon (on the right) has 'Increased Physical Damage'. You'll see that the weapon's Physical Damage is higher, and is a different colour. It is this number that is used when other modifiers, such as your passive skills, are used to calculate how much damage your attacks deal.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW: 物品詞綴會有兩種分類：「全域」詞綴作用方式與天賦一樣，而「區域」詞綴則只會作用於裝備本身。比較下列的武器，並且注意魔法武器(右邊)有「增加物理傷害」詞綴。你可以看到這件武器的物理攻擊比較高而且是不同顏色。這表示數字被其他詞綴作用，像是你的天賦，這將會計算出你的攻擊造成多傷害。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english:
The same is true for increases to armour on items that naturally provide armour, or increases to evasion on items that naturally provide evasion, and so on.  
			
Some mods, such as 'Increased Attack Speed', can appear on both weapons and armour. Like the Increased Physical Damage modifier, the Increased Attack Speed on the weapon shown below is local to the weapon, and changes that specific weapon's rate of attack. The gloves shown below also have Increased Attack Speed, but they affect any weapon you are holding and use the Attacks Per Second value displayed on the weapon to calculate how quickly you attack.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW:
物品上有增加護甲詞綴和增加閃避詞綴就是直接增加護甲和閃避。

例如「增加攻擊速度」詞綴會出現在武器和護甲上。像增加物理傷害詞綴，武器上的增加攻擊速度詞綴，只會作用於此武器上改變武器的攻擊速度。手套若是有增加攻擊速度詞綴，他們會作用於任何你裝備的武器，並且將計算出來的攻擊速度呈現在武器上。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.english:
The attack speed mod on these gloves is a global modifier, so it adds together with other global increases to attack speed, including those on your passive tree.
 
As a general rule (though there are occasional exceptions), if the values in the top section of an item are different to the normal basetype, they are benefitting from local modifiers. If a modifier on an item doesn't seem to be affecting anything in the top section, then it is global.

See if you can work out which mods are local and which mods are global in the image below.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCon.zhTW:
手套上攻擊速度詞綴是全域詞綴，所以它會先與其他的全域增加攻擊速度詞綴加總，包括在天賦樹上的詞綴。

一般來說(雖然會有些例外:P)，

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.english: This character has been granted life from their Iron Ring, as well as from their first passive skill. They also gained life simply by levelling up.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.zhTW: 此角色透過鍛鐵戒指和起初的天賦獲得生命。也可以透過升等獲得生命。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.english: By taking these two passive skills, this character also gains 4% and 5% increased maximum life. These add to a total of 9% increased maximum life.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.zhTW: 取得這兩點天賦點，此角色獲得 4% 和 5% 最大生命。總共增加 9% 最大生命。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.english: The global modifier (increased maximum life) increases all sources of maximum life, and after rounding, we land on this character's final life value.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.zhTW: 全域詞綴（增加生命）會增加所有生命的來源，在四捨五入後決定角色的生命值。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.english: The Full Scale Armour has one local mod (increased Armour and Evasion) and one global mod (Lightning Resistance). The Steel Gauntlets also have one local mod (increased Armour) and one global mod (increased Attack Speed). The Sharktooth Claw's increased Attack Speed mod is local, and so is the implicit (life gained on hit).
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsCalculationsCap.zhTW: 連身鱗甲擁有一條區域詞綴(增加護甲和閃避)和一條全域詞綴(閃電抗性)。冷鋼護手擁有一條區域詞綴(增加護甲)和一條全域詞綴(增加攻擊速度)。鯊顎爪的增加攻擊速度詞綴為區域詞綴，固定詞綴也是屬於區域詞綴（擊中回復生命）。

TutorialPanelGlossaryTitle1.english: Glossary of Common Game and Player Terms

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent1.english: A section of Path of Exile's main story. Each act has a Town, quests, and a story arc contained within it.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent1.zhTW: 流亡黯道主線故事的一部分。每章節都會有一個城鎮、任務和自己的故事。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent2.english: Any skill that performs an action is an active skill. Most skill gems provide you with an active skill.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent2.zhTW: 只要技能有呈現動作就是主動技能。每個技能寶石，甚至一些輔助寶時都會提供你主動技能。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent3.english: The modifiers (or mods) that are randomly assigned to items. A magic item can have two affixes; one prefix and one suffix. Most rare items can have six; three prefixes and three suffixes.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent3.zhTW: 詞綴會隨機配置於物品中。魔法物品最多可以有兩個詞綴；一個前綴和一個後綴。稀有物品最多可以有六個詞綴；三個前綴和三個後綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent4.english: [Bleeding], [Ignite], [Chill], [Freeze], [Shock] and [Poison]. [Ailments] can be removed by certain charms, or negated by items or passive skills.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent4.zhTW: [Bleeding|流血]、[Ignite|點燃]、[Chill|冰緩]、[Freeze|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]和[Poison|中毒]。[Ailments|異常狀態]可利用特定護符去除，或以物品或天賦減輕。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent5.english: The area in which a skill has an effect. A fireball's explosion has a small area of effect, while the secondary effect of Earthquake has a large area of effect.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent5.zhTW: 技能於範圍內作用。火球技能爆炸時會造成小的範圍效果。地震技能的二階段有大的範圍效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent6.english: The primary defensive stat from Strength-based equipment. Armour reduces the damage taken from physical attack and spell hits.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent6.zhTW: 力量基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為護甲。護甲會減少物理攻擊和法術擊中時所造成的傷害。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent7.english: A specialised subclass unlocked via the Labyrinth.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent7.zhTW: 透過帝王迷宮所解鎖的特殊副職業。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent8.english: One of the main skill types. With few exceptions, attacks use your weapon to calculate damage. Any skill gem with the "Attack" tag is an attack. Attacks can be both ranged and melee, and items and passive skills can affect ranged attacks or melee attacks exclusively. Some attacks, such as Spectral Throw, use a melee weapon but are not considered melee.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent8.zhTW: 主要技能類型之一。任何技能寶石標有「攻擊」標籤則為此類型技能。攻擊技能有遠距離和近戰，道具和天賦都可以分別影響這兩個類型。有些攻擊技能，像「靈體投擲」雖然使用近戰武器，但就不被列為近戰技能。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent9.english: Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. Most items have an attribute requirement.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent9.zhTW: 力量、敏捷、智力。大多數的物品都會有能力值的需求。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent10.english: A persistent field of an effect. If you step outside of an aura's radius, you won't be affected by it. Auras are also a specific set of skills that frequently reserve a portion of mana.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent10.zhTW: 在範圍內會一直作用效果。如果踏出光環範圍外，就不再獲得光環的效果。使用光環時通常都會需要魔力保存。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent11.english: A group of monsters that are summoned, under certain conditions, when many enemies are slain in close proximity.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent11.zhTW: 在某些特定狀態下，當擊殺成群的敵人，可以召喚出一群強大的怪物。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent12.english: A strong unique enemy. Every non-unique map has one or more map bosses, and every act has one or more act bosses.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent12.zhTW: 一個強大的傳奇敵人。每張非傳奇地圖都會有一隻或更多頭目。每個章節也都會有一隻或更多章節頭目。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent13.english: Visible as a clawed hand reaching out of the ground. Breaches grow in size and fill with monsters for a period of time. The more monsters slain within a breach, the longer the breach will remain open and continue to grow in size.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent13.zhTW: 像個魔爪從地面伸出來。啟動後裂痕範圍會成長，且範圍內充滿了裂痕怪物。擊殺越多的裂痕怪物，裂痕開啟的時間就會越長，直至最大範圍。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent14.english: The way a character is played or intended to be played. Eg. A Tornado Shot build uses Tornado shot as its primary skill, and most of the items and passive skills serve to improve the effectiveness of Tornado Shot.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent14.zhTW: 角色進行遊戲的方式和玩法。例如：龍捲射擊流派使用龍捲射擊技能做為主要攻擊技能，而使用的道具和天賦大多是來增強龍捲射擊的威力。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent15.english: One of the five damage types, along with Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning. Chaos damage bypasses Energy Shield by default.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent15.zhTW: 和火焰、冰冷、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。混沌傷害將無視能量護盾。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent16.english: Usually refers to the Marauder, Duelist, Ranger, Shadow, Witch, Templar and Scion playable characters.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent16.zhTW: 一般指野蠻人、女巫、遊俠、聖騎士、決鬥者、暗影刺客、貴族、七位可遊玩角色。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent17.english:
May refer to one of several things: Frenzy, Endurance, and Power Charges, which can be gained from items or skills, and which grant significant boosts to damage and attack/cast speed, damage reduction and resistances, and critical strike chance respectively. 

Charge may also refer to Flask charges, which determine how many uses a flask has. Flask charges are regained primarily by slaying monsters.

Charge can also reference the number of uses a skill has, such as some trap skills or Vaal skills that can store enough souls for multiple uses.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent17.zhTW:
一般意旨能透過物品、技能、天賦效果獲得的「狂怒球」、「耐力球」、「暴擊球」。它們能夠提供給你大量的能力強化，像是：傷害、攻擊/施法速度、傷害減免、抗性、暴擊率。

充能同時也可能意旨藥水的充能，主要用於判斷該藥水能夠使用的次數。回復藥水充能的主要方法為擊殺怪物。

最後，充能也可能意指某個技能在短時間內能夠使用的次數。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent18.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Lightning, Physical and Chaos. Cold damage can chill and freeze by default.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent18.zhTW: 和火焰、混沌、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。冰冷傷害能夠冰凍、冰緩敵人。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent19.english: One of the mysterious forces that is causing the dead to rise and life to mutate on Wraeclast. Also refers to the act of using a Vaal Orb on an item to change its properties. A corrupted item cannot be further modified.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent19.zhTW: 散佈於瓦爾克拉斯的神祕能量，使死者復甦，生者突變。同時意旨使用「瓦爾寶珠」在物品上使其汙染的動作。已汙染的物品將無法進一步修改屬性。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent20.english: The act of changing or creating an item. This can be done through the use of the various Orbs, Essences and Hideout crafting benches.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent20.zhTW: 無論是使用通貨、精髓、工藝台來創造或修改物品屬性皆屬於工藝製作。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent21.english: Usually refers to the various Orb items such as the Chaos Orb.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent21.zhTW: 一般意旨遊戲中各式各樣的「石頭」，例如：混沌石、崇高石、瓦爾寶珠、護甲片、磨刀石、點金石等等。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent22.english: An alternate Defence introduced in the Expedition League. Ward intercepts an amount of Damage taken from a single Hit, up to the total amount of Ward you have, before that Damage would be taken from your Energy Shield or Life. When this happens, Ward Breaks, and will be Restored after a short delay. Ward has no effect on further Hits while it remains Broken, but such Hits will also not reset the delay before it is Restored.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent22.zhTW: 在探險聯盟中引進的替代防禦手段。保護在從你的能量護盾或生命中受到傷害之前，會攔截一次擊中受到的一定量的傷害，最多為你擁有的保護總數。發生這種情況時，保護會破壞，並在一段時間後恢復。保護在保持破碎狀態時對進一步的命中沒有影響，但此類命中在恢復之前也不會重置延遲。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent23.english: Damage that occurs over a period of time without a 'hit'. Eg. Standing on burning ground, or the poison component of Viper Strike.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent23.zhTW: 任何在特定時間內持續發生的傷害。延伸參考：消耗傷害

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent24.english:
Armour, Energy Shield and Evasion are the three main defences. These are found on most non-weapon equippable items.

Ward is also a defence, and can be found on certain pieces of armour obtained from Expeditions and the Iron Flask.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent24.zhTW:
護甲、能量護盾、閃避為主要的三種防禦手段。能夠在大多非武器物品上取得。

保護也是防禦機制，可以從探險護甲上和鋼鐵藥劑尚發現。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent26.english: One of the three attributes, along with Strength and Intelligence. Dexterity passively grants some Accuracy and increases your Evasion.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent26.zhTW: 和力量與智力一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。敏捷能夠提升你的角色命中和閃避數值。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent27.english: A type of item that can be turned in at Tasuni in Highgate or Lilly Roth in your Hideout for the reward written on the card. Each of these was designed by a Path of Exile supporter.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent27.zhTW: 此類型道具在收集指定數量後可以與統治者之殿中的達蘇尼或你藏身處的莉莉羅斯兌換該卡片上敘述的獎勵。每一張卡片都是由流亡黯道的贊助者所設計。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent28.english: The primary defensive stat from Intelligence-based equipment. Energy Shield protects Life from all damage types except Chaos by default. Energy Shield also rapidly recovers after a period of taking no damage.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent28.zhTW: 智力基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為能量護盾。能量護盾會保護生命值不受到任何除了混沌傷害以外的傷害。能量護盾在沒有受到傷害一段時間後會迅速的恢復。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent29.english: Weapons, shields, helmets, body armours, boots, gloves, rings, amulets, and belts all count as equipment.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent29.zhTW: 武器、盾牌、頭盔、胸甲、鞋子、手套、戒指、項鍊、腰帶都屬於裝備。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent30.english: The primary defensive stat from Dexterity-based equipment. Evasion provides a chance to ignore incoming attacks. Evasion provides no benefit against spells.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent30.zhTW: 敏捷基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為閃避值。閃避值提供能夠無視攻擊的機率，閃避值對法術無效。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent31.english: Any NPC who was exiled from Oriath. Each of the player characters is also an Exile.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent31.zhTW: 任何被奧瑞亞逐出的人，玩家也屬於流亡者。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent32.english: One of the five damage types, along with Cold, Lightning, Physical and Chaos. Fire damage can ignite by default.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent32.zhTW: 和冰冷、混沌、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。火焰傷害能夠點燃敵人。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent33.english: An item type that sits in the flask slots and is used to gain some effect on the player character, such as restoring life or mana, or gaining a temporary buff. Flasks are refilled by slaying monsters, or returning to a Town or Hideout.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent33.zhTW: 放置於藥水欄位的道具，不同的藥水在使用後能獲得不同的效果。擊殺、返回城鎮、藏身處皆可回復藥水的充能。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent25.english: The Town in Act 2 that is sitting atop the river.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent25.zhTW: 第二章中坐落於河川上游。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent34.english: May refer to Skill Gems or Support Gems. Not to be confused with Jewels.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent34.zhTW: 意旨技能寶石或者輔助寶石。和珠寶不同。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent35.english: A mod which affects more than just the item it is on.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent35.zhTW: 影響範圍不限於所屬道具的詞綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent36.english: A collection of players that have access to a shared chat channel and a shared stash. Guilds can also have Guild Tags, a sequence of letters that represents which guild they are a part of.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent36.zhTW: 一群意志相投的玩家，共享同一個聊天頻道和倉庫。工會可以設定公會標籤，代表他們所屬的工會。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent37.english: An area owned by the player that can house Masters and crafting benches, and can be decorated and altered by the player. Hideouts are shared across all characters on the same league and account.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent37.zhTW: 玩家自有的空間，能夠自行布置，收留大師和他們的工藝桌。每個聯盟的藏身處是互通的。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent38.english: Any object that can be moved and placed within a Hideout.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent38.zhTW: 任何能夠在藏身處中擺設的道具。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent39.english: The Town on Mount Veruso, first encountered in Act 4.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent39.zhTW: 位於第四章節的主要城鎮。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent40.english: The mod that appears above the randomly generated mods on an item. This is guaranteed by the basetype that the implicit is on, but can be changed by a few different sources. The most common way to change an implicit is by using a Vaal Orb (see Corruption).
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent40.zhTW: 顯示於物品隨機生成詞綴上方的固定屬性，這條詞綴會根據不同類型的物品而定。雖然一般來說是固定的，但流亡黯道中存在能更改固定詞綴的方式，例如：瓦爾寶珠（參考：腐化汙染）

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent41.english: One of the three attributes, along with Strength and Dexterity. Intelligence passively grants some Mana and increases your Energy Shield.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent41.zhTW: 和敏捷與力量一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。智力能夠提升你的角色魔力和能量護盾。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent42.english: An item that can be socketed in the passive tree.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent42.zhTW: 一種能夠鑲入天賦樹的物品類型。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent43.english: Usually refers to rings and amulets. Sometimes also includes belts and jewels.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent43.zhTW: 一般指戒指、項鍊、腰帶、寶珠。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent44.english: One of the very large passive skills on the passive tree. Keystones drastically change the function of your character, and often come with a drawback.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent44.zhTW: 天賦樹中最顯眼的一系列天賦點，會從根本上改變一個角色的戰鬥風格以及各項配置。 它通常會有一項正面的增益效果，並搭配上一項負面的減益效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent45.english: A long, difficult dungeon that grants the player Ascendancy points upon completion. The layout changes every day.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent45.zhTW: 困難且複雜的迷宮，完成後能夠獲得昇華點數。迷宮的配置隨每日改變。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent46.english: Usually refers to items that have mods, mod values or other features that cannot be obtained through normal means anymore. May refer to the Legacy challenge league, which ran in 2017.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent46.zhTW: 所謂古典道具，是指該道具擁有目前已經無法再取得的詞綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent47.english: Players and some items have levels, used to track the progress or strength of a range of features.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent47.zhTW: 玩家和某些物品有等級，主要用來分辨進度或者強度。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent48.english: Determines whether your character is alive or dead. If your life falls to zero, you're dead.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent48.zhTW: 決定你的角色生死，若你的生命消耗至零，你將會死亡。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent49.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Cold, Physical and Chaos. Lightning damage can shock by default.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent49.zhTW: 和冰冷、火焰、混沌、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。閃電傷害能夠使敵人感電。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent50.english: The bridge between two sockets on an item, that allows skill gems to be supported by support gems.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent50.zhTW: 物品上插槽與插槽間的橋梁，使輔助技能寶石和技能寶石能夠互相影響。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent107.english: The remains of a fortress that now acts as the Town in Act 1.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent107.zhTW: 壁壘的殘骸現在為第一章節的城鎮。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent51.english: Any mod that only affects the properties of the item it is on, and not the character as a whole.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent51.zhTW: 任何只影響物品上屬性而非整體角色的詞綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent52.english: A keyword that denotes that a mechanic that has some randomness will be checked twice, and the best outcome of the two checks will be used.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent52.zhTW: 所謂幸運，是指某個變數在系統隨機產生兩次結果後，選擇使用對流亡者較有利的結果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent53.english: One of the tiers of rarity. Things that are of Magic rarity are tinted or coloured blue.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent53.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，魔法物品的名稱將會顯示為藍色。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent54.english: The primary resource for using skills, represented by the Blue orb on the UI.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent54.zhTW: 使用技能的主要資源，在玩家介面上透過藍色球狀物表示。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent55.english: Usually refers to the Map item type, which can be used in a Map Device to enter an area that is imbued with the mods that were present on the map when it was used. May also refer to the navigation tool on the UI.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent55.zhTW: 一般指一種道具類型，能夠透過製圖裝置使用開啟帶有各種詞綴的地區。同使可能指遊戲中的地圖介面。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent56.english: Any one of the NPCs which you encounter in the world and have special side missions for you to complete.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent56.zhTW: 你在鬼島中遇到任何會給你特殊任務的 NPC。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent57.english: Refers to the use of the crafting bench available in your Hideout.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent57.zhTW: 意旨使用在藏身處的工藝台對物品進行修改的動作。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent58.english: Any attack which is not ranged. Typically very close-range.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent58.zhTW: 任何非遠程的攻擊。一般來說範圍很近。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent59.english: A stationary object that can be placed and detonated by the player.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent59.zhTW: 靜止的物件，玩家能夠放置並且引爆。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent60.english: Usually refers to Mirror of Kalandra, the rarest currency item. A Mirrored item cannot be modified.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent60.zhTW: 一般指「卡蘭德的魔鏡」，遊戲中最為稀有的通貨物品。被鏡像的物品將無法進一步修改。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent61.english: Short for Modifier. Anything that modifies an item, area or skill is a mod.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent61.zhTW: 任何能夠改變/修正物品、地區、技能、角色效果的屬性，皆稱為詞綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent62.english: Short for Microtransaction. Usually refers to the cosmetic effects for sale in the shop.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent62.zhTW: 能夠透過商城取得的外觀效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent63.english: One of the rarity tiers. Normal items have no special qualities and appear white or uncoloured.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent63.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，普通物品的名稱將會顯示為白色，並且沒有特殊效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent64.english: Passive skills that are smaller than keystones but larger than most other passives. Notables usually provide strong benefits.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent64.zhTW: 核心天賦點比一般的天賦點大，比關鍵天賦小，具有較特殊的名字且提供較多的能力。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent65.english: Short for non-player character. Includes any character that can be talked to or traded with, but usually doesn't refer to enemies.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent65.zhTW: 包含任何能夠互動的非玩家角色，一般不是敵人。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent66.english: The small, sole-surviving city of the now defunct Sarn Empire. Each player character was exiled from Oriath.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent66.zhTW: 薩恩帝國唯一殘存下的城市。每位流亡者都是從奧瑞亞流放出來的。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent67.english: The powers obtained from major and minor gods are stored and selected on the Pantheon screen.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent67.zhTW: 從主神和次神取得的神之力會顯示在眾神殿介面中。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent68.english: Any group of two or more players that have joined forces. Players in a party all gain experience from slain monsters if they're close enough, and can chat to one another.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent68.zhTW: 任兩位以上玩家一同冒險。組隊中的玩家皆可獲得擊殺怪物所獲得的經驗，他們也能夠在隊伍中聊天交流。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent69.english: Anything you can assign a passive skill point to. Passive skills provide incremental benefits for the player character.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent69.zhTW: 任何能夠使用天賦點數啟用的效果。天賦能夠使你的角色越來越強大。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent70.english: The area surrounding Sarn, named for one of Sarn's early emperors.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent70.zhTW: 薩恩城周邊地帶，以薩恩較早期的帝王命名。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent71.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Chaos. Physical damage has no special features by default.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent71.zhTW: 和冰冷、火焰、混沌、閃電傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。物理傷害沒有其他特殊的效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent72.english: Created by using a Portal Scroll. Most portals take players to the nearest Town.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent72.zhTW: 一般來說透過傳送卷軸生成。大多數的傳送們將玩家送達最近的城鎮。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent73.english: One of the Affix categories. Prefixes are typically stronger than suffixes.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent73.zhTW: 詞綴的類型。一般來說前綴相較下比後綴來的強大。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent74.english: An attack or spell component which travels without being connected to the casting or attacking player.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent74.zhTW: 法術或攻擊的一部分，包含任何在飛行中不和施法或攻擊者相連的物件。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent75.english: Improves the effectiveness of weapon, equipment, skill gems, support gems, and other items. Quality is usually limited to 20%.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent75.zhTW: 品質會增加武器、裝備、技能寶石、輔助寶石和其他物品的效果。一般來說品質的上限為20%。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent76.english: A task which either forwards the story or rewards the player upon completion. Questgivers are indicated by a yellow '!' above their head.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent76.zhTW: 任務，一般來說會推進故事進度，或者提供給玩家獎勵。當NPC頭上顯示黃色「！」表示該NPC有任務需要你的協助。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent78.english: One of the rarity tiers. Rare items typically have up to six random mods. Rares are coloured or tinted yellow.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent78.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，稀有物品的名稱將會顯示為黃色，並且能擁有至多六條隨機詞綴。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent79.english: The term used to describe how many mods an item can have, or how strong an enemy is. There are four rarity tiers: Normal, Magic, Rare and Unique.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent79.zhTW: 一般指物品能擁有幾條詞綴，或者敵人多強大。物品稀有度階級一共分四個階級：普通、魔法、稀有、傳奇。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent80.english: A keyword which is short for "within the last four seconds".

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent81.english: Used to calculate the amount of damage dealt or taken by sources of Fire, Cold, Lightning or Chaos damage.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent81.zhTW: 用來計算受到或者造成的各種屬性傷害，包含火焰、冰冷、閃電、混沌。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent82.english: An enemy, usually clad in Microtransactions, that attacks with skills commonly used by players. Rogue Exiles drop an item from each equipment slot.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent82.zhTW: 敵人的一種，穿著華麗的商城物品，大多使用一般玩家會使用的技能。擊敗盜賊流亡者後他將掉落所有部位裝備各一件。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent83.english: The capital city of the Eternal Empire, and the primary location for Act 3.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent83.zhTW: 位於第三章的主要城鎮。不朽帝國的首都。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent84.english: The source of most active skills. Skill gems, when socketed in weapons or armour, grant a skill. This skill can be augmented by linking the skill gem with a support gem.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent84.zhTW: 主動技能的來源。當你將技能寶石插入武器或裝備的插槽時你將獲得該技能。此技能可以透過輔助寶石進一步增加效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent85.english: A slot where a Skill or Support gem can be placed in weapons or armour. The passive tree also has sockets, however these sockets can only hold jewels.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent85.zhTW: 位於武器或者裝備上的「洞」，能夠將技能寶石、輔助寶石插入。天賦樹中也存有插槽，但天賦樹中的插槽只能夠插入寶珠。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent86.english: One of the main skill types. Any skill gem with the "spell" or "cast" tag is a spell. Spells are unaffected by anything that affects attacks, unless an item or skill specifically says otherwise. Spells can create things that attack (such as Raise Zombie) but do not themselves count as attacks.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent86.zhTW: 主要技能類型之一。任何技能寶石標有「法術」標籤則為此類型技能。法術不受到任何攻擊的詞綴影響，除非該物品有特別說明。法術能夠創造出能夠攻擊的物件（像是殭屍復甦）但不代表該法術屬於攻擊技能。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent87.english: The primary way to store items and pass them between characters is via the stash. The stash can be expanded by purchasing stash tabs in the microtransaction shop.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent87.zhTW: 儲藏和同帳號角色之間物品交流的主要手段。前往商城能購買倉庫擴充頁。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent88.english: One of the three attributes, along with Dexterity and Intelligence. Strength passively grants some life and melee physical damage.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent88.zhTW: 和敏捷與智力一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。力量能夠提升你的角色生命和近戰物理傷害。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent89.english: A special kind of chest that can be modified with Currency. Almost all strongboxes are guarded by several packs of monsters, and cannot be opened until those monsters have been slain.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent89.zhTW: 可使用通貨道具修改的箱子。幾乎所有的保險箱都受到怪物守護著，必須清光這些怪物保險箱才會順利開啟。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent90.english: One of the two main affix groups. Suffixes tend to be weaker than prefixes. On Magic items and monsters, suffixes can be seen as the last part of the item's name (such as 'of Heat' or 'of Calm')
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent90.zhTW: 兩種主要詞綴的其中之一，相較前綴較為弱勢。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent91.english: Used to modify the behaviour, cost, and power of skill gems. Support gems have no effect by themselves and must be linked to a skill gem to have any effect.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent91.zhTW: 能夠使技能寶石的特性、消耗、強度產生變化。一般來說輔助寶石本身不帶有任何效果，必須與技能寶石連結才能夠顯現出它的價值。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent92.english: Any player who purchases a Supporter Pack or other microtransaction from the shop. Supporters keep the Path of Exile developers fed and happy. We love supporters!
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent92.zhTW: 曾購買任何贊助包或者商城道具的玩家。贊助者是流亡黯道的製作團隊的衣食父母，也讓製作團隊開心，我們超愛贊助者的。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent93.english: One of the past challenge leagues. Tempest is also the name of the signature effect of the Tempest challenge league. Tempests create fields around the world that influence player and monster behaviours, such as shrinking them or granting a speed boost.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent93.zhTW: 過去其中一期挑戰聯盟的名稱。風暴會在區域中產生並對區域中的怪物和流亡者們造成諸多變異，例如改變體型大小、造成傷害、改變掉寶率、甚至使掉落的武器自動幻化。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent94.english: A stationary object that can cast spells or attack remotely. Unlike traps and mines, totems have a life pool akin to minions. Unlike minions, totems can't typically move around, and are unaffected by minion modifiers.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent94.zhTW: 無法行動的物件，能夠遠端施放法術或攻擊。和陷阱和地雷不同的是，圖騰有自己的生命值，並且不會受到怪物詞綴的影響。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent95.english: Any location other than a Hideout where players can buy, sell, and stash items. Towns also contain quest-givers and other NPCs.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent95.zhTW: 任何非藏身處但可以販售、購買、使用倉庫的區域。城鎮中也會存在NPC和任務。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent96.english: The act of exchanging one good for another, typically between two players (rather than between a player and an NPC). There is a trade chat channel designed to allow players to advertise their items for sale.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent96.zhTW: 意旨玩家與玩家間的物品交換。遊戲中設有交易頻道，讓玩家有專門的管道能夠與其他玩家交易。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent97.english:
A stationary object that, when triggered, can attack or cast a spell. Traps break after they have been triggered, and can be easily destroyed by enemy attacks and spells, however they are also very difficult to see. 

May also refer to the traps in the Labyrinth which serve as damaging obstacles.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent97.zhTW: 靜止難以察覺的物件，被觸發後能夠攻擊或者施放法術。陷阱在觸發或者被敵人攻擊/法術擊中後會遭到破壞。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent98.english:
Typically refers to items or skill or support gems that cast a spell or deal an attack without the player's direct input. 'Cast on Critical Strike Support' is an example of a Trigger gem.

May also refer to the act of setting off a Trap.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent98.zhTW: 一般意旨某些不需要玩家直接使用的技能或輔助寶石。（例如：「暴擊時施放」就是典型觸發類的輔助寶石）

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent99.english: One of the rarity tiers. Uniques do not have randomly generated names or mods, setting them apart from the other rarity tiers. Unique monsters are typically very strong, while unique items can provide a wide range of effects not available on other items.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent99.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一。和其他階級的物品不同，傳奇物件沒有隨機生成的名稱或詞綴。傳奇怪物一般來說非常強大，傳奇物品則會提供眾多其他其他道具上不會出現的特殊效果。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent100.english: The oldest known culture on Wraeclast. The Vaal were the first known users of the gems, and their ruins are scattered across the land. Traces of the Vaal can be seen most notably in Act 2, and in the corrupted side areas. Vaal may also refer to the act of "Vaaling" an item -- using a Vaal orb on an item to corrupt it.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent100.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯最古老的文明，是古靈寶石最早的使用者。他們的遺跡四散在各個地區，尤其在第二章節中更能夠找到瓦爾的蹤跡。瓦爾同時也代表使用瓦爾寶珠「瓦」某些物品使該物品受到汙染的動作。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent101.english:
Typically refers to the act of selling an item at an NPC for scraps and fragments.

May also refer to the NPC themselves.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent101.zhTW: 一般指將物品販賣給商人換取各種通貨碎片的動作。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent102.english: A stacking effect that grants offensive attack bonuses for each stack. Stacks will be lost over time if you avoid combat for too long.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent102.zhTW: 一種疊加效果，每疊加一層都會提供攻擊性加成。如果你長時間避戰，疊層將隨著時間的推移而丟失。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent103.english: A subset of skills that are not attacks or spells, and thus are unaffected by things that ordinarily affect attacks and spells. The potency of any Warcry skill is affected by how many enemies are nearby when it is used.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent103.zhTW: 不屬於攻擊也不是法術的一系列技能，也因此不受到一般會影響攻擊與法術的詞綴所影響。戰吼的效力主要基於使用時附近怪物的數量。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent104.english: The primary way of saving your progress through the world of Path of Exile. Waypoints allow travel to any other waypoint that you have previously found.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent104.zhTW: 流亡黯道中主要紀錄進度的方式，傳送點使你能夠在已經開啟的傳送點之間互相傳送。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent105.english: A type of item that can only be equipped in the main-hand and off-hand slots. Weapons are a major factor in the damage dealt by most attacks, and can also influence which skills you can or cannot use.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent105.zhTW: 一系列只能夠裝備於武器欄位的物品，是大多攻擊造成傷害量的主要指標，同時不同類型的武器也決定你能否使用某些技能。

TutorialPanelGlossaryContent106.english: The largest continent in Path of Exile's known world. Criminals on Oriath are exiled to Wraeclast, a mysterious continent with a murky and bloody history. Most of Path of Exile's main storyline takes place on Wraeclast.
TutorialPanelGlossaryContent106.zhTW: 奧瑞亞的罪人將被流放到瓦爾克拉斯，流亡黯道世界中最大最神秘的大陸，擁有血腥神秘的歷史背景。流亡黯道中大部分劇情皆在瓦爾克拉斯上發生。
