TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantT.english: Stats and Mods II: What to Look Out For
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantT.zhTW: 數值和詞綴 II：到底該留意些甚麼

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english: Character builds in Path of Exile are extremely varied, and which items and passives are important to a character is highly dependent on what that character is trying to achieve, but there are some things almost everyone should look out for.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW: 在流亡黯道中角色玩法和流派極為多變，不同的道具和天賦的價值也因此依每個流派的需求而異。雖然如此，還是有某些屬性是幾乎每個角色都用的到的！

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english: Because of the properties of Fireball, this staff increases Fireball's damage by 66%.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW: 因為火球的特性，這把長杖將能夠增加火球的傷害整整 66%

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english:
Unless you're in a coordinated group, every character needs a way to kill monsters. Figure out how you plan to deliver damage and look for items that amplify that. If you plan to shoot arrows at monsters from afar, a high-damage bow, as well as passive skills that benefit your chosen weapon, are a must. 

If you plan to cast spells, look for weapons with 'increased Spell Damage'. If you're strictly dealing fire damage, look for things that boost your fire damage. A fire spell like Fireball benefits from increases to fire, spell, and projectile damage. A character who wants to smash things with a one-handed mace should look for modifiers to one-handed weapons, maces, attacks and melee attacks specifically.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW:
除非你時常和親朋好友組成特殊隊伍，否則幾乎每個角色都需要利用某種方式殺死怪物。找出造成傷害的方法，接著收集可以加強它的道具。如果你想遠遠的對敵人發射箭矢，一把攻擊力高的弓和加強弓系傷害的天賦幾乎可以說是必備的。

如果你想施放法術，那麼你可以嘗試尋找有「增加法術傷害」的武器。如果你對火屬性情有獨鍾，那麼你也可以把焦點擺在火屬性傷害加成的道具。舉例來說「火球」，它不僅可以被「增加火焰傷害」影響，也能夠受到「增加法術傷害」、「增加投射物傷害」的影響。一位想要使用單手錘打扁怪物的角色，可以把焦點擺在「單手武器傷害」、「單手錘傷害」、「攻擊傷害」、「近戰傷害」相關的詞綴。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english: Weapon-specific passives are often stronger than more generalised passives, but you lose some flexibility in which items you can use.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW: 限定武器的天賦一般來說比廣泛影響的天賦來的強力，但同時你失去了武器選擇的彈性。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english:
You can't kill monsters if you're dead, so you should also carefully consider your defences. Most characters will want some armour, energy shield or evasion, or some combination of the three. Sources of life and increases to it are a great way to extend your lifespan, but you'll also want to seek out ways to mitigate the damage before it ever touches your life pool. 

Fire damage, such as the fire from a cannibal's thrown torch, can be mitigated by sources of 'Fire Resistance'. Merveil's spells deal cold damage, so 'Cold Resistance' is very useful against her. If a certain spell or attack deals significantly more damage to you than anything else, it might be of an element that you don't have much resistance to. If you're ever unsure where you spend your next passive point, it's almost always worth investing in a relevant defence.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW:
不論你再怎麼厲害，死了一切都是浮雲。在提升角色能力的同時，你也可以多多研究你的防禦手段。大多角色選擇使用護甲、能量護盾、閃避、或者混搭。同時基礎生命和增加生命相關的來源也非常受歡迎，但最有效的方式就是在傷害還沒碰到你的生命池前就已經被減免緩和了。

火焰傷害，可以透過「火焰抗性」來減免。莫薇爾的法術造成冰冷傷害，所以「冰冷抗性」對付她非常有效。如果遊戲中突然發現某些技能對你的角色造成特別多傷害，可能是因為你對應的抗性過低。如果你不確定接下來的天賦該往何處發展，防禦手段幾乎都是不錯的選擇。

TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.english: Not too shabby! As you progress, you'll be able to fill some gaps using the crafting benches given to you by characters called Masters.
TutorialPanelStatsAndModsWhatsImportantC.zhTW: 還不賴！隨著角色的成長，你可以透過大師提供給你的工藝台來補足需求。

TutorialPanelStashContent1.english: While out in the wilds of Wraeclast, you might've run out of bag space and found that you couldn't pick anything else up. Luckily, every Town and Hideout in Path of Exile comes with a stash. The items you put in your stash can be accessed wherever a stash can be found. You'll find the same items you stashed in Lioneye's Watch waiting for you at the Forest Encampment, your Hideout, and anywhere else with a stash.
TutorialPanelStashContent1.zhTW: 在瓦爾克拉斯流亡的同時，你可能會發現包包時常滿到不能再拾取任何物品了。好在每個城鎮和藏身處都配置了一個私人倉庫。而且每個倉庫的空間都是互相流通的，你在獅眼守望放進倉庫的物品，在森林營地、你的藏身處、或者任何其他城鎮的倉庫中都能找到。

TutorialPanelStashCaption1.english: Every Town and Hideout has a stash.
TutorialPanelStashCaption1.zhTW: 每個城鎮和藏身處皆有倉庫。

TutorialPanelStashContent2.english: In fact, all your other characters in the same league can also access the same stash, so if you get a great bow while playing your Marauder, you can stash it to use on your Ranger later.
TutorialPanelStashContent2.zhTW: 帳號中隸屬相同聯盟下的角色皆使用相同的倉庫空間，當你使用野蠻人冒險時找到了一把不錯的弓，你可以透過倉庫轉移給你的遊俠使用。

TutorialPanelStashContent3.english: At some point you may find yourself running low on stash space. Extra stash tabs can be bought in the Microtransactions shop, and once purchased, will be available in every league. They come in a few different varieties:
TutorialPanelStashContent3.zhTW: 流亡一段時間後你可能會覺得自己的倉庫空間漸漸無法滿足需求。不必擔心，額外的倉庫頁可以透過商城購買，而且一旦購買日後每一個聯盟都可以使用。倉庫頁分幾種類別：

TutorialPanelStashCaption2.english: Basic stash tabs are functionally identical to your free tabs.
TutorialPanelStashCaption2.zhTW: 一般倉庫頁和起初免費的倉庫頁擁有一樣的功能。

TutorialPanelStashCaption3.english: Premium stash tabs can be labelled and colour-coded for ease of use, and allow you to list items for sale. You can price each item individually or set a price that applies for every item in the tab.
TutorialPanelStashCaption3.zhTW: 高級倉庫頁提供了命名和更改標籤顏色的功能，也使你可以設置販售該頁面中的道具。你可以單獨為想販售的道具標價，或者將整個倉庫頁設為均一價。

TutorialPanelStashCaption4.english: The specialised stash tabs, such as the Currency stash tab, can hold thousands of specific items, far exceeding the normal stack-size limits, and keep them neatly organized.
TutorialPanelStashCaption4.zhTW: 特殊倉庫頁，如通貨倉庫頁，能夠儲藏上千個特定物品，完全高出平常的堆疊限制，而且還擺的整整齊齊。

TutorialPanelStashContent4.english:
All stash tabs have a search bar at the bottom that lets you search for and and filter out items, so you can quickly find what you are looking for.

The items in your stash never go away. However, when a temporary league ends, all the items in your stash will be moved to the stash in its permanent equivalent.

When this happens, your items can be found in stash tabs labelled "Remove Only". These will hold your items indefinitely, but anything removed from a Remove Only tab can't be returned to that tab.
TutorialPanelStashContent4.zhTW:
每一種倉庫頁的下方都提供了搜尋的功能，讓你可以迅速方便的找到自己的物品。

倉庫中的物品永遠不會消失。然而當挑戰聯盟或者短期聯盟結束後，它們將會被移動至對應的長期聯盟中。

這類轉移發生後，你的道具將會出現在長期聯盟的倉庫中，分頁名稱將顯示為「只能取出」，這些倉庫頁雖然沒有保存期限，但如其名稱所指出，物品取出後是無法放回去的。「只能取出」倉庫頁被清空後，重新登入遊戲後將會消失。

TutorialPanelStashCaption5.english: Remove-only tabs keep your items safe and sound after a challenge league ends.
TutorialPanelStashCaption5.zhTW: 「只能取出」倉庫頁會完善保存你的物品。

TutorialPanelNavigationContent1.english: Wraeclast is pretty big, and is full of places you'll want to visit and revisit. To help you get around, the land is dotted with 'Waypoints' which let you quickly travel to destinations you have previously visited. To use a waypoint, activate it and select where you would like to travel. You can only travel to waypoints you've activated previously, so it is always worth activating new waypoints when you come across them.
TutorialPanelNavigationContent1.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯是個非常大的陸地，也有很多地方是時常需要拜訪的。為了讓流亡者更容易跑腿，地圖上會出現許多傳送點，讓你在啟用後能夠迅速的往返。

TutorialPanelNavigationCaption1.english: Selecting a quest icon on the World Panel will display a path to the next step of the quest.
TutorialPanelNavigationCaption1.zhTW: 選擇任務圖示後，世界面板將會顯示下一步的路線。

TutorialPanelNavigationContent2.english:
When you click on a waypoint, the panel that pops up is called the World Panel. It doesn't just show your waypoints, however; It also displays every area you have previously visited, as well as some connected areas you haven't been to yet. Your quests are listed below the map, and by selecting one you can highlight the path that you need to follow to complete it. 

Because areas in Path of Exile have varying degrees of random generation, you may not always recognize the layout of an area, even if you've been there several times. The minimap or map overlay may also be different and will need to be revealed again. This may take some getting used to, but it means no two playthroughs are exactly the same.
TutorialPanelNavigationContent2.zhTW:
點擊傳送點後，世界面板將會彈出。它將會顯示出所有你已經拜訪過的地區，同時也會顯示出相連的為探索區域。你的任務會顯示在地圖的下方，選擇任務圖示後，世界面板將會顯示下一步的路線。

在流亡黯道的世界中，每次進入一個區域，該地圖都有隨機生成的機制，所以就算你已經拜訪過某些區域數次，你可能還是沒辦法一眼確定地形。這也代表每次遊戲都有比較不一樣的體驗。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent1.english: Monsters throughout Wraeclast won't just hurt you -- they can also inflict [Ailments]. Fortunately, you can too.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent1.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯各地的怪物不只會對你造成傷害，它們還會施加[Ailments|異常狀態]。幸運的是，你也可以這麼做。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent2.english: [Ailments] usually come from a specific kind of damage. [Fire] damage can '[Ignite]', which deals further fire damage over time. [Cold] damage can '[Chill]', slowing you down, or '[Freeze]', causing you to stop moving entirely. [Lightning] damage can '[Shock]', causing you to take a lot of extra damage from any source. Some enemies can also '[Poison]' you or inflict '[Bleeding]', both of which deal damage over time. If you move while you're bleeding it will deal extra damage.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent2.zhTW: [Ailments|異常狀態]通常會由特定類型的傷害所造成。[Fire|火焰]傷害可以「[Ignite|點燃]」，進一步造成火焰持續傷害。[Cold|冰冷]傷害可以「[Chill|冰緩]」，使你的速度減慢，或是「[Freeze|冰凍]」，使你完全無法移動。[Lightning|閃電]傷害可以「[Shock|感電]」，使任何來源都會對你造成大量額外傷害。部分敵人還能使你「[Poison|中毒]」或施加「[Bleeding|流血]」，兩者皆會造成持續傷害。若你在流血時移動，則會造成額外傷害。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsCaption1.english: Each ailment typically comes from a specific type of damage, though some unique items can change this.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsCaption1.zhTW: 異常狀態一般來自特定的傷害，但某些傳奇物品可以改變規則。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent3.english: Items, passive skills, support and skill gems, curses, and other things can each influence how likely it is that you'll suffer or inflict any of these [Ailments], as well as how effective these ailments are.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent3.zhTW: 物品、天賦、輔助和技能寶石、詛咒和其他要素，都會影響你承受或造成這些[Ailments|異常狀態]的機率，以及這些異常狀態的效力。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsCaption2.english: Unique items and passive skills can prevent you from suffering from specific [Ailments], or grant something beneficial when you're suffering from one.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsCaption2.zhTW: 傳奇物品和天賦可以防止你被施加特定的[Ailments|異常狀態]，或是當你正在承受異常狀態時，賦予某種增益效果。

TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent4.english: Flasks are capable of removing each [Ailments|ailment] if they have the right mods. Figuring out which ailments might be dangerous to you and getting flasks that will remove them can make a big difference to your journey.
TutorialPanelStatusAilmentsContent4.zhTW: 若具備正確的詞綴，藥劑便能將每種[Ailments|異常狀態]移除。考慮哪一種異常狀態可能會對你造成危險，並使用能將其移除的藥水，如此一來你的旅程將變得更加輕鬆。

TutorialPanelSocialContent1.english: Path of Exile is an online game where you can talk, trade, and play with other players whenever you want.
TutorialPanelSocialContent1.zhTW: 在流亡黯道中你將能夠與其它玩家一起遊玩、聊天、交易。

TutorialPanelSocialContent2.english: There are several chat channels enabled by default, which can be toggled on and off using the buttons at the top of the chat window. You can also select which channel you want to talk in via the drop-down menu at the bottom.
TutorialPanelSocialContent2.zhTW: 流亡黯道的聊天室預設就已經為你開啟了多個聊天頻道，你可以透過聊天室上方的按鈕將它們關閉。聊天時你可以透過左下角的下拉式選單選擇你要發言的頻道。

TutorialPanelSocialCaption1.english: You can link items in chat with Ctrl + Alt + Left-click
TutorialPanelSocialCaption1.zhTW: 按下 Ctrl + Alt後左鍵點擊物品將可以把該物品資訊發送至聊天視窗。

TutorialPanelSocialContent3.english: The Social panel (Hotkey S) is where you can quickly access your friends list, guild and party. Once you add a friend, both their account name and character name will be visible to you. If they have a Hideout and have enabled their friends to enter it, you'll be able to enter their Hideout from this menu while in your own Hideout or a Town.
TutorialPanelSocialContent3.zhTW: 透過社交面板（快捷建：S）你可以迅速的瀏覽你的好友、公會、隊伍資訊。成功登錄好友後，你將能夠看到對方的帳號名稱和角色名稱。如果你的朋友擁有自己的藏身處並且開放他人參觀，你將能夠透過此介面前往參觀。

TutorialPanelSocialContent4.english: You can also use this panel to join public parties created by other players, or create your own.
TutorialPanelSocialContent4.zhTW: 你也可以使用此面板建立自己的公開隊伍或加入其他玩家的公開隊伍。

TutorialPanelSocialContent5.english: If you're looking to buy, sell, or exchange items with another player, you can open the trade window by right-clicking a character in the world. If they're in your party, you can trade by right-clicking their character portrait. Items up for trade must be checked by each player before the trade can be completed, to ensure you know exactly what it is you're trading for.
TutorialPanelSocialContent5.zhTW: 若希望與其他玩家進行買賣或者是交換物品，你可以使用右鍵點擊其他玩家並選擇交易的選項。如果對方與你處同一個隊伍之中，點擊對方的角色頭像也能夠開啟交易視窗。每次的交易中雙方玩家都必須使用鼠標確認交易的物品，否則將無法完成該交易，提醒流亡者們務必留意交易的內容。

TutorialPanelSocialContent6.english: Path of Exile's players come from all walks of life, and the Path of Exile community is an important part of what makes Path of Exile so much fun. So please remember to be respectful when you talk to other players.
TutorialPanelSocialContent6.zhTW: 流亡黯道中的玩家來自各地，也都是使流亡黯道社群熱絡的重要一員。在與其他玩家互動時也希望大家能表現出最基本的禮儀，尊重、包容、友善。

TutorialPanelPropheciesContent1.english:
Prophecies are similar to the quests that characters like Tarkleigh send you on, however they are less structured, less predictable, and can only be acquired from Navali in exchange for a silver coin. 

Prophecies can do a broad range of things. Some can guarantee that certain items will drop from specific monsters. Some add new monsters to areas, some drastically change the look of certain areas, and some grant avenues to new or upgraded unique items.
TutorialPanelPropheciesContent1.zhTW:
和一般的任務相似，但更難以捉模，沒有一定的模式，只能透過娜瓦莉花費銀幣隨機取得。

預言能提供非常廣泛的效果。有些能夠保證特定的物品從特定的怪物掉落。有些會為地圖增加更多怪物，有些甚至會改變地區的樣貌，有些還能夠將傳奇物品升級成更強大的版本。

TutorialPanelPropheciesContent2.english: Sometimes you may get a prophecy that you don't want or need at that moment. Navali can seal such prophecies for some silver coins, turning it into an item that you can store in your stash or trade to another player.
TutorialPanelPropheciesContent2.zhTW: 偶爾你可能會取得對你目前沒有用處的預言，這時你可以花費銀幣請娜瓦莉協助將它封印。封印後的預言會轉化成一件可以儲藏、交易的物品道具。

TutorialPanelPropheciesContent3.english: While some prophecies can grant you access to powerful and valuable rewards, sometimes the prophecy IS the reward. Remember, you can end up fulfilling a prophecy without meaning to, so it's always worth considering spending some silver to save a nice crafting prophecy for an item that could greatly benefit from it.
TutorialPanelPropheciesContent3.zhTW: 有些預言會引領你取得極有價值的獎勵，但別忘了有些預言本身的效果就是價值的所在。為了不要不經意的浪費掉某些稀有的預言，有時將它們封印起來是非常明智的選擇。

TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent1.english:
You can modify a vast number of objects in Path of Exile using the various orbs, scrolls, essences, whetstones and other stacking consumables. Collectively these items are referred to as "Currency", as they are also used to trade and barter with both NPCs and other players. At higher levels you might find currencies that other players value highly.
 
The Orb of Transmutation, Orb of Alteration and Orb of Augmentation are great items to carry and use during your journey. They can be used to upgrade normal items to magic and to reroll or change the mods on magic items, and they're common enough that you can pretty quickly replace whatever you use. Using these currencies on flasks can let you customize their behaviour.
TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent1.zhTW:
在流亡黯道中你能夠使用多種道具對物品進行改造，像是點金石、精髓、磨刀石、卷軸等消耗型道具，一般稱之為\「通貨\」，因為它們時常被當作交易貨幣的一種，隨著你的等級提升，你也將能夠找到更有價值的通貨。

改造石、蛻變石、增幅石都是非常常見也是平常帶在身上極為有用的通貨物品。它們能夠將普通物品升級成魔法物品，或者改變魔法物品的詞綴和屬性。使用在藥水上也能為你帶來更多不同的效果。

TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent2.english:
If you're in need of a damage boost, try using them on a weapon base-type that is close to your level. Sometimes a magic item with the right mods is better than a rare item with the wrong ones.

We've listed out some of the more common currencies, and what they do, just below:
TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent2.zhTW:
若你需要更多傷害，不妨試試將他們用在與你等級相近的武器上，有正確詞綴的魔法武器有時比起錯誤詞綴得稀有武器來的好用。

以下為更多常見的通貨物品和它們的用途：

TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent3.english:
There are many more currency items than just these, and they can be used in other ways. Later on, you will be able to fill your Hideout with devices which let you spend currency to modify your items very precisely.
			 
If you've accumulated a few of a type of currency, don't be afraid to try using it on an item. Sometimes the results will surprise you!
TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyContent3.zhTW:
除了上述的通貨以外，流亡黯道中還存在更多通貨與他們讓人意想不到的用途。隨著你的進度推進你也將會獲得藏身處工藝台，讓你消耗通貨更的同時更加準確的改造你的物品。

如果你已經取得了很多通貨，並且有多餘的武器道具，不妨嘗試使用它們，有時它們的結果會帶來驚喜。

TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyCaption1.english: Even strongboxes can be modified with currency. Keeping some with you will give you a degree of control over the contents of the strongboxes you come across.
TutorialPanelCraftingAndCurrencyCaption1.zhTW: 即使是保險箱也能夠受到通貨的影響。身上隨時攜帶通貨能夠讓你遇到保險箱時多少控制保險箱的內容物。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent1.english: There are many little tips and tricks that you will naturally pick up as you play Path of Exile, but here's a few that will make life in Wraeclast easier.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent1.zhTW: 在流亡的旅途中你將自然而然的學習到許多有幫助的訣竅，在那之前以下提供幾個對你接下來在瓦爾克拉斯的時間可能有所幫助的建議。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent2.english: While your stash or a vendor window is open, you can hold down 'Ctrl' and click items to quickly move them into or out of your inventory.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent2.zhTW: 倉庫或者商人視窗打開的時候，按住 Ctrl 並左鍵點擊想要移動的道具可以省略拖曳的動作。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent3.english: If you run out of room in your stash, you can buy more stash tabs in our in-game microtransaction shop. The same is true if you run out of character slots.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent3.zhTW: 如果你的倉庫頁或者角色欄位放不下了，遊戲中的商城頁面提供多種倉庫頁和角色欄位讓流亡者們購買。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent4.english: Holding Alt while hovering over an item in your inventory will display it against what you have equipped. It will also show any extra information if the item uses some complex or obscure game terms.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent4.zhTW: 按住 Alt 鍵的同時，將鼠標移至物品上方將可以和目前角色裝備中的物品做比較，也可以看到該物品的詳細資訊。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent5.english: At high levels you may find that item drops fill up your screen. In the UI tab of the Options menu you'll find an option to turn on an item filter. Item filters will limit which items are displayed and when.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent5.zhTW: 隨著畫面上的掉落物變多，你可能會開始覺得地圖過於雜亂。在介面設定中你可以設置物品篩選器，將能夠訂製物品顯示的規則。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent6.english: If you pick up a cool unique item or see a skill gem you want to use but it doesn't suit your build, stick it in your stash! Remember, your stash is shared across all of your characters in that league. Don't be afraid to make a new character and try out a new build. Building new characters is a big part of what makes Path of Exile so much fun.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent6.zhTW: 撿到很酷的傳奇物品，還是突然找到了某顆想要使用的技能寶石了嗎？想使用卻與你目前的流派不搭？不用擔心，將它們收藏到你的倉庫中吧，別忘了你的倉庫與其他相同聯盟下的角色是共享的。不要害怕嘗試更多的職業、更多的角色和流派，流亡黯道會受歡迎的原因不就是因為流派的多樣性嗎？

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent7.english: Currency that enhances an item's quality works more effectively on Magic and Normal items. If you want to craft an item or need an item with a certain amount of quality, try enhancing the item before you upgrade its rarity.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent7.zhTW: 提升道具品質類的通貨，當使用在魔法或一般稀有度的物品上時效益最高。在製作某些物品前建議可以先使用品質類通貨後再提升物品的稀有度。

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent8.english: Some item mods, such as "Squire's" on weapons and "Beetle's" on armour-based body armours, can give the appearance of actually being two mods. These are hybrid mods, and are actually single mods that grant two stats at lower values. That means you may still be able to craft an extra mod onto that item! If you're unsure if you have room on an item or not, try putting it in a Master's crafting bench.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent8.zhTW: 某些出現在武器或者胸甲上的詞綴，乍看之下是兩條詞綴，實際上它可能是複合式詞綴，由兩條較低數值的效果組成。若不確定是否為複合式詞綴，建議你可以將該物品放進

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent9.english: If you ever get stuck, don't be afraid to ask for help. If players in the global chat can't answer your questions, you can always visit our forums.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsContent9.zhTW: 如果不幸的卡關了，不要害怕，問就對了！如果世界頻道的玩家沒辦法回答你的問題你也可以試試官方論壇、各大論壇或者客服中心喔！

TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsCaption1.english: Your stash has a field at the bottom that lets you filter out items.
TutorialPanelHelpfulTipsCaption1.zhTW: 你的倉庫頁底部設有搜尋功能讓你能更輕易的找到你的道具。

TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent1.english: Auras are skills that persistently affect things around you. Most auras, such as 'Hatred', affect you and your nearby allies and party members. They usually grant some sort of benefit, but reserve a portion of your mana for as long as you keep them activated.
TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent1.zhTW: 光環是一系列對你的角色有持續效果的技能。大部分的光環，如「憎恨」會影響你與你的隊友。一般來說它們帶給你某種增益效果，但同時在它們啟用時會保留你魔力的一部分。

TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent2.english: Some auras instead affect your nearby enemies. The 'Blasphemy Support' turns any supported curse into an aura that reserves some mana and curses any enemy that enters its radius.
TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent2.zhTW: 有些光環僅會影響你周遭的敵人。「詛咒光環輔助」寶石會將它輔助的詛咒的效果轉換成光環，並和一般光環一樣保留你的魔力，同時影響附近的敵人。

TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent3.english:
Reserved mana can't be used or recovered until whatever is reserving it is disabled, so consider whether you will be able to use your skills with the mana you have remaining. Things that change how skills interact with your mana (like 'Blood Magic') also apply to mana reservation.
 
Heralds also reserve mana and grant benefits that are similar to some of the aura skills, however they only affect you. Heralds also have special behaviours that interact with ailments.

Some auras don't reserve mana or don't persist indefinitely. This is true of Vaal versions of auras such as Vaal Grace.

Vaal auras have a limited duration but grant very powerful bonuses for the short time they are active.
TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsContent3.zhTW:
被保留的魔力不能被使用也無法回復，直至對應的光環被停用。因此在啟動光環時必須留意剩餘的魔力是否足夠讓你可以靈活的使用你的技能。

捷光環，和一般光環較為不同的是，它只影響你自己。各個捷光環對於異常狀態都有對應的效果。

某些光環不保留魔力也不會永久維持效果。瓦爾版本的光環就是如此，像是瓦爾．優雅。

瓦爾光環雖然提供強大的增益效果，但持續時間非常的短暫。

TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsCaption1.english: Each Herald skill interacts in some way with its associated ailment.
TutorialPanelAurasAndHeraldsCaption1.zhTW: 各個捷光環對於異常狀態都有對應的效果。

TutorialPanelJewelsContent1.english:
Jewels are items that have mods just like your weapons and armour. However, instead of being equipped, they are socketed in the passive skill tree.

Jewels only work when they're socketed in a jewel socket that has been allocated with a passive point. If they are in an unallocated socket, the jewel won't do anything.
TutorialPanelJewelsContent1.zhTW: 珠寶和你的武器和裝備一樣擁有詞綴。然而它們無法直接裝備，必須透過天賦樹上的插槽才能夠獲得珠寶的效果。

TutorialPanelJewelsContent2.english:
Just like other items, jewels can be normal, magic, rare or unique. They can be modified with currencies like other items, though unlike your weapons and armour, a rare jewel can only have up to four mods. 

Cluster jewels are a type of jewel that can only be socketed in the outer rim of your passive tree. These come in 3 sizes, small, medium and large, and allow you to expand your passive tree with new passive nodes, notables and even more jewel sockets!

Some unique jewels, such as Efficient Training above, can modify the passive skills around them:
TutorialPanelJewelsContent2.zhTW:
就像其他物品一樣，珠寶也有分魔法、稀有、傳奇稀有度。珠寶也能夠受到通貨物品的改造，但不像一般的武器和裝備，珠寶最多只能擁有 4 條詞綴。

星團珠寶也是珠寶的一種，只能放置於你天賦樹外圍的插槽。星團珠寶有 3 個大小：小、中、大，並且可以讓你擴張你的天賦樹，有額外的天賦點、核心天賦和更多珠寶插槽！

部分傳奇珠寶，像是充分訓練，可以調整他們附近的天賦：

TutorialPanelJewelsCaption3.english: Some unique jewels have a radius and change the behaviour of passive skills within that radius.
TutorialPanelJewelsCaption3.zhTW: 某些傳奇珠寶甚至會改變它周遭的天賦的效果。

TutorialPanelJewelsContent3.english:
The colour of a jewel affects the likelihood of it having certain mods, but has no effect on your ability to socket it.

Since the number of jewels you can socket is only limited by the number of jewel sockets you've allocated, some unique jewels have limits placed on them. If you have more of that type of jewel than the limit allows, the extra jewels won't have any effect.
TutorialPanelJewelsContent3.zhTW:
珠寶的顏色意味著不同詞綴能在該珠寶上出現的機率，任何顏色的珠寶都能被插入置任何珠寶插槽中。

某些珠寶帶有同一時間能作用的數量限制，若你的角色天賦插入該珠寶的數量超出珠寶上所標示的數量限制，額外的珠寶將不會有任何效果。

TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent1.english:
Throughout your journeys you will encounter other exiles. The Forsaken Masters are a set of such exiles who, when found, will offer you a quest for the area you're in. Each Master has a different style of quest, and within those quests there are many randomised features, so although you might have a general idea of what your task may be, the specifics may vary greatly. Be prepared!

If you succeed in helping one of these Masters, they will gain experience and eventually level up. Whenever a master levels up, you unlock something within their realm of expertise.
TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent1.zhTW:
在流亡的旅途中你會遭遇其他流亡者。其中「被遺忘的大師」當你遇到他們時，會提供給你當前區域的任務。每位大師的任務模式都不太一樣，而且包含些許隨機的因素在。

若你成功完成大師們的任務，他們會獲得經驗值，完成夠多的任務就能夠使大師們提升等級。每當大師升級，他們也會將自己的專業領域透過其他的方式分享給你。

TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent2.english: When a Master reaches level 3, they can grant you the ability to create a Hideout -- a place all to yourself that you can decorate as you see fit. If you have a Hideout, a Master of level 2 or higher can also give you their crafting bench.
TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent2.zhTW: 當大師等級達到 3 等時，他們將給予你能夠建立自己藏身處的功能。一個屬於你自己的地盤，一個隨心所欲的佈置的空間。當你已經擁有一個藏身處後，當大師達到等級 2 他們將會提供給你特別的工藝桌。

TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent3.english: Each Master's crafting bench offers different crafting options. Elreon's Blessing Font primarily works with rings and amulets, for example, while Vagan's Sharpening Wheel improves melee weapons. As you level up the associated Master, their crafting bench options grow.
TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent3.zhTW: 每位大師的工藝桌都不同，提供的工藝選項也有所區別。舉例來說博學大師的工藝桌主要提供戒指、項鍊相關的詞綴，而武器大師的工藝桌則較專注於近戰武器詞綴。隨著大師的等級提升工藝桌的選項也會增加。

TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent4.english: Masters also buy and sell items. At high levels, some of the items they offer can't be found anywhere else. They will also sell Hideout decorations in exchange for favour, which is earned as you help them. Their range of decorations for sale also grows as they level up.
TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent4.zhTW: 大師也會買賣物品，大師所賣的物品有些在別處是找不到的。大師也會販賣藏身處裝飾品，但購買裝飾品必須消耗友好度，透過平常協助他們解任務來取得的點數。隨著大師的等級提升，販售的裝飾品也會越多。

TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent5.english:
Masters in your Hideout can also offer you a daily mission. Daily missions take the same structure as their ordinary missions but offer significantly more Master experience and favour. Whenever you complete a Master's daily mission their inventory of wares for sale changes.

Be sure to check your Hideout daily if you want to rapidly level up your Masters!
TutorialPanelForsakenMastersContent5.zhTW:
每位被邀請至藏身處的大師每天會提供給你一項任務。這些每日任務和平時的大師任務模式相似，但能夠獲得比平時更多的大師友好值。每當你完成大師的每日任務，該大師所販售的物品將刷新。

若想要迅速的升級你的大師，記得每天都拜訪一下藏身處的大師！

TutorialPanelVendorRecipesContent1.english:
You may have noticed that sometimes when you sell some items to an NPC you get something unexpected. You may have encountered a 'vendor recipe'!

Items with certain properties, or specific combinations of items, can be sold together to fulfil a recipe. Listed below are a few useful examples:
TutorialPanelVendorRecipesContent1.zhTW:
你可能發現，當你將某些物品販售給NPC時偶爾會出現意想不到的物品，流亡黯道中稱之為「交易配方」。

物品上不同的屬性或者擁有某些特性的物品同時販售給NPC後會達成特定條件，能夠取得對應的道具，以下為常較為用的範例：

TutorialPanelVendorRecipesContent2.english:
There are many more than these, some of which are complex and result in powerful unique items or valuable currency. 

Try experimenting with different combinations of items. You might just stumble upon a new recipe.
TutorialPanelVendorRecipesContent2.zhTW: 除了上述配方外，還有更多更複雜的配方，有些說不定會給予你強大的傳奇物品或價值連城的通貨。

TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent1.english:
The Labyrinth is a dungeon unlike any other in Path of Exile. It is filled with perilous traps, valuable secrets, tricky puzzles, and objectives that may require you to do things across several areas. 
			
To gain access to the Labyrinth, you must complete the six prerequisite trials that are scattered across the first three acts. A portal to the Aspirants' Plaza will then appear in the centre of the Sarn Encampment, and it is in the Aspirants' Plaza that all versions of the Labyrinth can be reached.
TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent1.zhTW:
帝王迷宮與流亡黯道中其他地牢不同。帝王迷宮中充斥著陷阱、秘密、謎題、甚至會需要你在多個區域完成目標。

若想進入帝王迷宮，首先你必須完成前個章節中出現的六種試煉，即可前往薩恩城進入試練者廣場。

TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthCaption1.english: Best each of the six trials and you can enter the Aspirants' Plaza via the Sarn Encampment.
TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthCaption1.zhTW: 完成全六種試煉，即可前往薩恩城進入試練者廣場。

TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent2.english:
Successfully navigating the Labyrinth ultimately leads to a sequence of fights with the Labyrinth's creator, Izaro. Failure to survive the Labyrinth means starting again, so be careful where you step.
 
If you manage to make it to the end, you'll be rewarded with treasure, an opportunity to enhance an item, and the ability to select your Ascendancy class.
TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent2.zhTW:
在帝王迷宮中順利前進，你將會遇上帝王迷宮的創造者，伊澤洛。在迷宮中死亡代表著從頭開始，流亡者必須全神貫注，步步為營。

成功到達迷宮的終點，你將會獲得寶藏、附魔道具的機會、和昇華職業的選擇。

TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthCaption2.english: The Labyrinth's structure changes every day, but you can view the sequence of chambers as you progress through them, as well as what features they may hold.
TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthCaption2.zhTW: 迷宮的構造每天都會改變，但隨著探索，你將能看到每個區域的順序和內容。

TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent3.english:
There are four versions of the Labyrinth, each with a different set of entry requirements, and each reward you with two Ascendancy points upon completing it for the first time. 

Unlike most areas in Path of Exile, the Labyrinth's structure does not change greatly between runs during the same day, but once a day the layout is randomised.
TutorialPanelTheLabyrinthContent3.zhTW:
帝王迷宮目前有四種版本，各個版本都有各自進入的條件，第一次完成後也各會獎勵你兩點昇華點數。

不像流亡黯道中其他的地區，帝王迷宮除了每天隨機重置以外當天的迷宮不論進入幾次都不會有太大的改變。

TutorialPanelAscendanciesContent1.english:
Although any class in Path of Exile can eventually reach any passive skill on the passive skill tree, each class has their own distinct set of Ascendancy classes. A Witch can, for example, eventually become an Elementalist, but a Templar cannot. 
 
You can unlock your Ascendancy class by completing the Labyrinth and using the Altar of Ascendancy in the final room. Higher-tier Labyrinths then grant two more Ascendancy points when you reach the Altar of Ascendancy, for a total of 8 points.
TutorialPanelAscendanciesContent1.zhTW:
雖然流亡黯道中任何職業都可以隨心所欲的擴展天賦，但每個職業都擁有屬於自己的昇華職業。舉例來說，女巫將能夠昇華成為「元素使」但聖騎士卻不行。

在第一次完成帝王迷宮後點擊昇華盤即可選擇解鎖昇華職業，後續更高階的帝王迷宮中，每次完成都會獎勵你額外 2 點昇華點數，每隻角色最多可以取得 8 點昇華點數。

TutorialPanelParentLeaguesTitle.zhTW:
一般、專家
和自力模式

TutorialPanelParentLeaguesContent1.english:
The two primary modes for playing Path of Exile are Standard and Hardcore. In Standard, if your character dies, you respawn at a nearby checkpoint and have the opportunity to try again. At higher levels you will start to lose a portion of your experience when you die. Don't worry, you can't go down in level from dying too much.
 
In Hardcore, however, one death means you're out. Characters that die in Hardcore are sent to Standard, along with any items they were carrying. To reach a high level in Hardcore is a big achievement -- one that even very experienced players struggle with.
TutorialPanelParentLeaguesContent1.zhTW:
流亡黯道中最主要的兩種遊戲方式為「一般」或「專家」模式。在一般模式中若你的角色死亡你將會重生在最近的城鎮或者重生點，後期當你的角色死亡你將會失去一部份經驗值。但也別擔心，即使你的角色已經沒有經驗值，死亡也不會使你降低等級。

在專家模式中，每個角色只有一次機會。專家模式死亡的角色和身上的物品將會被轉移至一般模式。在專家模式達到高等是非常優秀的成就，即便是老手也必須努力奮鬥一番。

TutorialPanelParentLeaguesContent2.english:
Both of these modes also have a Solo Self-Found (SSF) variant. In these SSF leagues players cannot team up or trade with any other players. That means the only items they have access to are the ones they've found or made. Players in SSF leagues can opt-out at any time and join the community of players in Standard (if they were playing Standard SSF), or Hardcore (if they were playing Hardcore SSF). 
 
There is no tangible benefit to playing Hardcore or SSF -- only the prestige. So if the idea of not being able to play with others or being booted out of your league if you die doesn't appeal, don't worry. It's the same game no matter how you choose to play.
TutorialPanelParentLeaguesContent2.zhTW:
每個聯盟都包含「自力」版本，在自力模式中玩家將無法組隊和交易。一切裝備、道具都必須靠自己的角色努力而來。自力角色隨時都可以選擇退出自力模式，退出後將會加入同聯盟下其他的玩家。

選擇遊玩專家或自力模式沒有額外的獎勵，只有對自己的挑戰和榮譽感。所以若對於這類遊戲模式沒有興趣，別擔心，不論甚麼模式下流亡黯道的遊戲內容都是一致的，想怎麼遊戲自己決定最重要。

TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesContent1.english: Path of Exile launches new temporary challenge leagues several times a year. These temporary leagues always have some twist or new gameplay mechanic that changes how you play, and a fresh economy. Everyone starts with nothing in their stash or on their character, other than a few flasks and scrolls. These leagues usually last about three months.
TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesContent1.zhTW: 流亡黯道每年都會推出多個短期的「挑戰聯盟」。這些短期聯盟都將包含不同的遊戲機制或新奇的規則，同時也提供所有流亡者一個全新的經濟，平等的起點。這些短期聯盟一般會持續三個月。

TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesCaption1.english: Many favourite Path of Exile features started out as challenge league mechanics: strongboxes, essences, breaches and tormented spirits, just to name a few.
TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesCaption1.zhTW: 流亡黯道中目前的許多遊戲機制幾乎都來自過來的許多短期聯盟；像是保險箱、精髓、裂痕、罪魂等等。

TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesContent2.english:
Challenge leagues also come with a set of special challenges (hence the name!). If you complete enough, you can earn exclusive microtransactions and Hideout decorations that are only available from that league.

When a challenge league ends, all of the items, characters, Atlas progress, and virtually anything else you can think of, transfer to their parent leagues, the permanent Standard and Hardcore leagues. Once everything has transferred across to Standard or Hardcore, you can continue playing those characters where you left off.

The start date of a new challenge league is usually announced several weeks in advance, and the first day of a new league is always very exciting, and bustling with players. The great majority of Path of Exile players play in these temporary challenge leagues. If you've never had a chance to experience it, we recommend joining us for the next one!
TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesContent2.zhTW:
挑戰聯盟，如其名，帶來一系列挑戰。完成夠多挑戰，你將能獲得該聯盟獨家的商城道具和藏身處裝飾品。

當短期挑戰聯盟結束時，所有的道具、角色、輿圖進度、大師等級、和所有你能想到的皆會轉移合併至對應的聯盟。轉移完成後你還是可以繼續遊玩這些角色。

每個挑戰聯盟的開始時間都會在開始前幾周宣布，而每個新聯盟都會有最多的流亡者加入。大多流亡者選擇在挑戰聯盟中進行遊戲，如果你還沒體驗過，我們邀請你加入我們下一個短期聯盟！

TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesCaption2.english: Complete enough challenges within a league and you can earn an exclusive Hideout decoration.
TutorialPanelChallengeLeaguesCaption2.zhTW: 完成足夠的聯盟挑戰，你將能獲得獨家的藏身處裝飾品。

TutorialPanelDivinationCardsContent1.english:
Divination cards are items found throughout Path of Exile that can be turned in for a reward. Different divination cards reward you with different things, including currency, specific item basetypes, other divination cards, and even unique items that can't normally be found. There are even some items that can only be obtained by collecting the right cards.
 
Every divination card was designed with the help of our supporters, though the rarity and drop locations were determined by Path of Exile developers.

Some divination cards can only be found in certain locations or from certain enemies, so pay attention to where you are when you find them. If there's one you really like, you might consider visiting that area frequently to find more.
TutorialPanelDivinationCardsContent1.zhTW:
你將能夠在瓦爾克拉斯各地找到命運卡，不同命運卡給予不同的獎勵，從通貨、特定基底物品、更多的命運卡、甚至是平常無法取得的傳奇道具。

某些命運卡只會在特定的地圖或者特定的怪物身上掉落，多多留意它們的來源，若有中意的命運卡，不妨時常去該區域打轉。

TutorialPanelDivinationCardsContent2.english: The number of cards you need to turn in for the reward is visible on the card itself. If you have a full stack of cards in your inventory or stash, the value on the icon will be blue instead of the usual white. Once you have enough, Tasuni in Highgate or Lilly Roth in your Hideout will accept them and reward you with the prize on the card.
TutorialPanelDivinationCardsContent2.zhTW: 命運卡上會顯示需要收集的數量。當你收集到該數量，數字會轉變呈現藍色。統治者之殿的達蘇尼和你藏身處的莉莉會非常樂意接受你的卡片並提供給你對應的獎勵。

TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent1.english: Path of Exile is completely free to play. You can't buy items, experience boosts, or anything that provides power, and you can do every bit of content without ever spending a cent. That said, we greatly appreciate our supporters as they allow us to continue to develop the game we love.
TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent1.zhTW: 流亡黯道是一款完全免費的遊戲。不花一毛錢也可以完整體驗流亡黯道的所有內容。我們也非常感激所有願意支持流亡黯道的贊助者，這使我們能夠繼續開發我們所愛的遊戲。

TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent2.english:
To that end, cosmetic items and stash tabs can be purchased from the Microtransaction shop. If you run out of stash space, the store sells extra stash tabs (you can even buy them in bulk!). If you would like to organise your stash to a greater degree, premium stash tabs and specialised stash tabs such as the Currency tab are available for purchase.

There's also a wide variety of cosmetic items available for purchase. Some replace the appearance of an item, while some add to the appearance of the items you're already wearing. Some even completely change the way a particular skill looks. After you buy a cosmetic microtransaction, you can proudly display it by opening your inventory panel and navigating to the Cosmetics tab. From here you have the ability to display any cosmetic microtransaction you own in its appropriate slot.
TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent2.zhTW:
為此目的，商城中可以購買外觀效果，若你的倉庫空間不足夠，商城也提供許多倉庫擴充的選擇。

外觀效果的選項眾多，有些會代替物品的外型、有些會為你的穿著增加更多特效。有些甚至會完全改變技能的效果。購買後只需要前往道具介面中的外觀分頁即可裝備它們。

TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsCaption1.english: The Cosmetics tab is accessible from the Inventory screen.
TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsCaption1.zhTW: 你可以透過你的道具介面前往外觀分頁。

TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent3.english:
Many players who want to support Path of Exile opt to buy Supporter Packs, which contain points for purchasing microtransactions as well as forum titles, player portrait frames, exclusive cosmetics that are only available from those packs, and more. Each Supporter Pack is only available for a limited time. Once it gets taken off the market, it never returns.
 
If you would like to support us and the continued development of Path of Exile, please consider visiting our Shop.
TutorialPanelMicrotransactionsContent3.zhTW: 希望支持贊助流亡黯道的玩家可以選擇購買贊助包，一般來說贊助包將包含黯幣、論壇頭銜、角色外框、每期限定的獨家外觀造型，等等更多。每個贊助者包都有上架期限，一旦下架就再也不會重新販售。

TutorialPanelPantheonContent1.english:
The Pantheon lets you selectively enhance your character for the dangers that lay ahead. By defeating any of the major or minor gods in Part 2, your character gains access to that god's Pantheon power.

You can have one major and one minor Pantheon power active at any given time. Each Pantheon power only enhances a narrow aspect of your character's survivability, so carefully consider what you are likely to soon face, and select a power that'll best help you.

You can only change which Pantheon powers are active in a Town or Hideout, but doing so is entirely free.
TutorialPanelPantheonContent1.zhTW:
眾神殿系統讓你自行選擇強化角色的方式。擊敗任何主神或次神都能解鎖該神的眾神殿能力。

同一時間能夠啟用一個主神和一個次神之力。每一個神之力會提供給你特定的生存能力，評估你接下來將會遇到的敵人並選擇最合適的神之力。

你必須在城鎮或藏身處中才能更換神之力，更換神之力為完全免費的功能。

TutorialPanelPantheonContent2.english: At later levels you can upgrade each power, broadening the protection it provides. To do so, you have to obtain a Divine Vessel and put it in your map device, then open a map that contains one of the map bosses displayed on the Pantheon.
TutorialPanelPantheonContent2.zhTW: 眾神殿中的能力在後期將可以透過眾神聖器強化，得到更廣泛的防禦能力。將眾神聖器放置在地圖裝置中並開啟眾神殿對應的地圖。

TutorialPanelPantheonCaption1.english: Once you've defeated the map boss, your filled Divine Vessel will be waiting for you in the map device.
TutorialPanelPantheonCaption1.zhTW: 擊敗地圖頭目後，你的眾神聖器將會裝滿力量在製圖裝置中等著你取回。

TutorialPanelMappingContent1.english: Although the main storyline ends at Act 10, hundreds (if not thousands!) of hours of fun still lay ahead, by way of a special kind of item called maps.
TutorialPanelMappingContent1.zhTW: 即使流亡黯道的劇情在第十章節完結，輿圖和它的地圖系統還有上百小時(甚至上千小時)的遊戲體驗等著你。

TutorialPanelMappingContent2.english:
Maps are items that open up brand new areas through the Map Device, located in the Epilogue area. High level monsters in the last few Acts can drop the earliest maps, but higher tier maps can only be found within other maps. 

Like other items, maps can be normal, magic, rare or unique, and have a wide pool of mods that affect both the difficulty and reward of the areas they open. Carefully crafting your maps for challenges that suit your build is an important part of Path of Exile's map system. It's always worth checking the mods on a map before you try to complete it. Some of them can be very punishing!
TutorialPanelMappingContent2.zhTW:
地圖道具可以透過置圖裝置開啟全新的地區，最後幾個章節的高等怪物將會掉落最初期的地圖道具，更高等的地圖道具必須在地圖中才有可能掉落。

就像其他物品，地圖道具也分為一般、魔法、稀有和傳奇地圖，並且有整個系列的詞綴能夠影響每張地圖的難度和獎勵。多多留意每張地圖的詞綴，因為有些詞綴可是非常難纏的。

TutorialPanelMappingContent3.english:
You can view which maps you have completed in your Atlas (default hotkey G). You can also further influence the properties of each map by applying a sextant to the Atlas icon. Sextants last for a limited number of maps and affect every map within its radius. While in a map, enemies can drop any maps of a lower tier that you have previously completed, as well as maps of a higher tier that the map you are in is connected to. Map bosses have an especially high chance to drop a map. 

Maps also have a bonus objective; usually to complete the map as a specific rarity. Completing this bonus objective increases the chances of finding higher tier maps. The higher the map tier, however, the harder it is to obtain even higher tier maps.
TutorialPanelMappingContent3.zhTW:
你可以在輿圖中看見你已經完成過的地圖(預設按鍵：G)。透過六分儀你能夠進一步影響每張地圖的屬性，六分儀使用後會給予周遭一定次數的影響。

地圖中的怪物有機會掉落你已經完成的較低等地圖道具，或者與當前地圖相連的更高等地圖道具。地圖頭目掉落地圖道具的機率特別高。

輿圖上每張地圖都會有個特殊目標，一般來說會要求你該地圖特定稀有度的版本。完成特殊條件將會給予你更多獲得更高階地圖的機會。然而，隨著地圖的等級提升，更高階地圖的掉落率也會下降。

TutorialPanelMappingContent4.english:
Later, you'll find Shaper's Orbs which let you upgrade the tier of a map, increasing the difficulty and levels of the monsters within.

Most players aim to work their way towards the centre of the Atlas in the hopes of challenging The Shaper, a very difficult but rewarding boss.
TutorialPanelMappingContent4.zhTW:
往後，你還會找到塑界玉，使用在對應階級的輿圖上可以使該地圖階級提升。

大多流亡者會把目標放在輿圖的中心，望著最後能夠挑戰塑界者，非常困難但也有豐厚獎勵的頭目。

TutorialPanelPvPContent1.english:
Path of Exile features several player-versus-player (or PvP) modes. At the top of the Sarn Encampment is an entrance to Sarn Arena, an area for open, unstructured player-slaying.

Want something more structured? You can duel individual players, or form a team and fight as a group. Path of Exile also supports a Capture the Flag game mode.

There are two main PvP brackets -- Open PvP, which has no limits on player level, and Low Level Dueling (LLD) which is limited to players of level 28 or below.

Leo Redmane in the Sarn Encampment offers daily PvP missions, and rewards active PvPers with Hideout decorations and crafting options, similar to other Forsaken Masters.

Dying in a PvP area on a Hardcore league does not send you to Standard, but if you die to another player outside of a PvP area, such as during the Act 2 Bandit questline, you will be sent to Standard as normal.

Note that special damage scaling rules are in place for PvP to level the playing field to some degree. Even so, the difference in both player skill and gear can be extreme, so don't become discouraged if you get slaughtered on your first try.
TutorialPanelPvPContent1.zhTW:
流亡黯道中提供了多種玩家對玩家(PVP)的遊戲模式。在薩恩城最上方可以進入薩恩競技場，一個開放式的自由對戰區域。

想要更有規則的模式嗎? 你可以和其他玩家單挑，或者組成隊伍進行組隊戰鬥，甚至參加搶旗競賽。

PVP的競賽主要分為兩個類別，開放式PVP：玩家等級無限制，和低等PVP：玩家等級限制在 28 等以下。

薩恩城中的赤焰鬥者里歐，如同大師一樣也會提供流亡者每日PVP任務，用藏身處裝飾品、工藝桌獎勵PVP活躍玩家。

在專家模式中，就算在PVP區域死亡也不會被轉移至一般聯盟。

流亡黯道的PVP存在特殊的傷害修正，以更加平衡PVP體驗，雖然如此玩家的流派和技術差距還是有非常大的差距，所以如果你的第一次被慘電，也不要過於灰心。

TutorialPanelCustomerSupportContent1.english:
Path of Exile's customer support team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. If you experience abuse or harassment while playing Path of Exile, you can report the abusive players by right-clicking their name in the chat window, and the support team will investigate the issue.

If you have a question or problem, try searching the Path of Exile forums to see if someone else has had a similar experience that has been resolved before you contact support. If you cannot find a resolution to the problem you are facing, please email support@grindinggear.com.

If you're experiencing payment or microtransaction problems or account issues, please email support@grindinggear.com. Someone will be in contact with you as soon as they can. We aim to have an extremely quick response time, but rest assured if there's any delay we're working to respond as soon as we can.

If you're experiencing technical issues, please try searching the Technical Support section of the Path of Exile forums for possible solutions.
TutorialPanelCustomerSupportContent1.zhTW:
若遇到任何遊戲相關的問題建議你可以先至各大論壇查看是否有其他玩家有和你相同的疑問，說不定已經獲得了解答。

如果遭到其他玩家騷擾，遇到了不好的遊戲體驗，你可以右鍵檢舉該玩家，我們的查緝團隊將會調查該玩家的行為。

同時有任何問題皆可以前往 Garena 客服中心尋求協助。

https://tw.support.garena.com/

ItemDescriptionUniqueFragment.english: This item will transform when correctly arranged with other items.
ItemDescriptionUniqueFragment.zhTW: 此物品在和其他物件擺放正確後將會有所改變。

TutorialPanelHelpContent1.english:
The Help Panel is designed to introduce you to Path of Exile's many features, and provide you with enough information to start engaging with them. This is not a comprehensive guide, and we encourage learning through experimentation to discover the depths that each part of the game has to offer. 

Each page of the Help panel is unlocked as you encounter the associated feature or reach an appropriate level. 

If you are looking for something specific and can't find it here, you may not have encountered it yet, or we may not have made a Help page for it. If you have any questions not answered here, please visit our official forums at www.pathofexile.com/forum.
TutorialPanelHelpContent1.zhTW:
幫助面板將會提供給流亡黯道中許多功能的使用方式，但這只為流亡者打開功能的大門，並不會太詳細說明每個功能的所有使用方法，我們不希望將流亡黯道的一切拱手獻上，希望每位流亡者都能靠自己的學習體驗流亡黯道的深度。

幫助面板的每一頁會隨著你的等級和進度解鎖。若你正在找尋解答但幫助面板中沒有出現對應的答案，可能是你還沒達到對應的條件。當然，也有可能是這頁我們還沒做出來，這時我們建議你可以透過各大論壇或者其他玩家找尋解答！

TutorialPanelAscendanciesContent2.english: Once you've chosen your Ascendancy, you can change it by returning to the Labyrinth, refunding any allocated Ascendancy points (Refunding an Ascendancy point costs five refund points each), and selecting a new class at the Altar of Ascendancy.
TutorialPanelAscendanciesContent2.zhTW: 即便選擇了昇華職業，只要將你的昇華點數完全重置（每點昇華點數消耗 5 點重置點數）並回到帝王迷宮即可重新選擇你的昇華職業。

TutorialPanelHideoutContent1.english:
Once you have rescued Helena from the Chamber of Sins in Act 2, she will offer you a quest to claim and populate a Hideout. Your Hideout is your own private space, and is shared by all of the characters on your account, regardless of league (though access to certain things within your Hideout is still restricted by league). It comes with a stash, a guild stash if you're in a guild, a waypoint, and a crafting bench. 

The crafting bench comes with several basic recipes by default, but many more can be unlocked as you journey through the campaign and participate in side content such as the Azurite Mine and the Eternal Labyrinth. Typically an item may only have one crafted mod at a time, but any existing crafted mod can be replaced via the Crafting Bench for a small additional cost.

You can also invite the masters to your Hideout. There are currently 5 masters -- Einhar, Niko, Alva, Jun and Zana -- although you can invite Helena and Navali to your Hideout as well. Each master has a gameplay mechanic associated with them, such as capturing beasts for Einhar.
TutorialPanelHideoutContent1.zhTW:
當你在第二章罪孽之殿解救赫蓮娜後，她會給予你任務來獲得並佔領一個藏身處。你的藏身處是你自己的私人空間，並且被你帳號中所有的角色共享，不論任何聯盟(但藏身處中的部份物品仍會被聯盟所限制)。藏身處中包含倉庫、公會倉庫(若你有參加公會)、傳送點和工藝台。

工藝台預設有幾個基礎的配方，更多配方將在你探索戰鬥和參與額外內容(像是碧藍礦坑和帝王迷宮)時解鎖。基本上，一個物品一次只能有一個工藝詞綴，但現有的工藝詞綴可以用小小的額外花費在工藝台上被取代。

你同時也可以邀請大師至你的藏身處。目前有 5 位大師 -- 埃哈、尼科、艾瓦、瓊恩和札娜 -- 但你仍可邀請赫蓮娜和娜瓦莉。每位大師都有相對應的遊戲機制，像是幫埃哈捕捉野獸。

TutorialPanelHideoutContent2.english:
Besides the functional objects within your Hideout, you can place hundreds of special Hideout decorations. Some of these come with your Hideout, but many more can be purchased with Favour, a resource earned by helping masters like Einhar and Niko. Each master has their own Hideout decorations they can sell, though what is available is limited by the master's decoration level. Each master has a different requirement for raising their decoration level. You can see the requirement by hovering over their level when talking to them. 

Your Hideout, the masters within it, and all your decorations, both placed and stored, are all shared across all leagues. That means your Hideout will be the same on Standard as it is in a challenge league. The recipes available on your Hideouts crafting bench are not, and must be rediscovered in temporary leagues.
TutorialPanelHideoutContent2.zhTW:
你的藏身處中除了功能性的物品，你可以擺放佈置上百個裝飾物。有些是藏身處附贈的，但更多的是透過大師友好度購買，友好度可以透過幫助大師來獲得，像是尼科和艾瓦。每位大師都會販賣專屬的裝飾物，但可購買物品也會隨著大師裝飾等級而有所限制。每位大師提升裝飾等級都有不同的需求。你可以在與他們交談時查看他們所需求的等級。

你的藏身處，裡面的大師和所有裝飾物，都會被放置和保存，並且共享至所有聯盟。這表示你的藏身處在標準聯盟和挑戰聯盟會是一樣的。工藝台上的配方則不會共享，短期聯盟一定要再重新探索一次。

TutorialPanelHideoutContent3.english:
Not happy with the look of your Hideout? Many new Hideouts can be found through exploration and gameplay, including some very rare ones found exclusively in the Atlas of Worlds, so keep your eyes peeled. Others can be purchased directly from the Microtransactions store.

You can swap your Hideout to any you've unlocked by talking to Helena. Any decorations you've placed in your old Hideout will remain there until reclaimed, so you can swap between Hideouts safely without fear of your time spent decorating going to waste!
TutorialPanelHideoutContent3.zhTW:
不滿意你藏身處的樣子？有很多新的藏身處可以在探索和進行遊戲時找到，包括一些相當稀有且只能在異界輿圖上找到的藏身處，所以請睜大你的眼睛。也有些藏身處可以在商城中直接購買。

你可以跟赫蓮娜交談來切換你已解鎖的藏身處。所有你放置在舊藏身處的裝飾物都會被保留至下次你在使用時，所以你可以放心的切換藏身處，不用擔心你千辛萬苦裝飾的藏身處會付諸流水！

TutorialPanelHarbingerContent1.english:
In your travels you may come across mysterious entities with names in a language you don't recognise - Harbingers from an unknown realm. These Harbingers can create and command monsters from the area, and empower them with their own abilities.

You can't directly harm the Harbingers yourself, but defeating a Harbinger's monster allies hurts the Harbinger as well. Successfully defeating a Harbinger earns you currency shards of both existing currency types and currency types exclusively available from these entities.
TutorialPanelHarbingerContent1.zhTW:
神秘的敵人會隨機出現在整個瓦爾克拉斯，用著瓦爾克拉斯人們不曾聽過的語言，他們未知的身世之謎等著被解答。神諭可以在地區召喚出許多聽命於他們的怪物，並使用他們獨特的能力增強怪物。

你無法直接傷害到神諭，必需要透過摧毀他們的召喚物來擊敗他們。神諭身上帶著你所熟悉通貨的碎片。當神諭死亡時也會掉落些過去流亡黯道中不曾見過的通貨碎片。

TutorialPanelHarbingerContent2.english: One of these currency types may lead you to the source of the Harbinger incursion. If you can halt their arrival, you'll find pieces of shattered unique items that can be arranged to form powerful Harbinger-summoning uniques.
TutorialPanelHarbingerContent2.zhTW: 如果你能找到神諭的起源地並阻止他們降臨，就有機會可以發現強大傳奇道具的碎片。蒐集完全部的碎片後，在背包中將它們重新排列，碎片將會鍛造成一個完整的裝備。這些傳奇裝備可以讓你在戰鬥時操控神諭並增強你的能力。

TutorialPanelAbyssContent1.english: Throughout the latter half of Path of Exile, you will find fissures (called Abysses) which open as you approach them, and monsters will spill out from below. You can pursue these cracks as they form, and they will lead to difficult encounters with great rewards.
TutorialPanelAbyssContent1.zhTW: 流亡黯道後期會遇到碎裂的地面（名為深淵）。接近它們碎裂的面積會越來越大，恐怖的怪物會從漆黑的深處爬出。延著碎裂的縫隙走，你可能會發現一個大裂口，那邊將會出現許多危險致命的生物和豐富的獎勵。

TutorialPanelAbyssContent2.english:
Time is an important element when following an Abyss. Each Abyss you encounter will close after a short duration, but may spread further if you can slay enough monsters in time. If you're quick and a little bit lucky, an Abyss chest may appear at the end of the sequence of events.

By slaying Abyss monsters you may be able to obtain items not found anywhere else:
TutorialPanelAbyssContent2.zhTW:
時間在深淵是很重要的。每個遇到的深淵都會在短時間內關閉，但如果你可以即時殺掉深淵怪物，深淵的裂縫就會蔓延。如果你清怪速度很快又很幸運的話，你可以在裂縫的最後發現深淵保險箱。

擊殺深淵怪物時，你可能會獲得其他地方沒有的道具：

TutorialPanelAbyssContent4.english:
Abyss jewels are special jewels with their own pool of mods. Unlike ordinary jewels, Abyss jewels have multiple tiers of many of their mods, as well as level requirements. They can also be socketed in a new type of item socket -- the Abyssal socket -- as well as in the passive skill tree. Abyssal sockets can be found on the Stygian Vise belt base type.

At higher levels, some Abyss events will lead into subterranean areas with special bosses. The most dangerous of these bosses can drop special Abyss league-exclusive unique items with Abyssal sockets.
TutorialPanelAbyssContent4.zhTW:
深淵珠寶是個很特別的珠寶，有屬於它們自己的詞綴。不像其他一般的珠寶，深淵珠寶的詞綴有許多各種階級，等擊需求也是。它們可以被放置在新的插槽種類--深淵插槽--，也可以放置於天賦樹中。深淵插槽可以在新道具：冥河腰帶上發現。

在高等地區的深淵，有機會引導至地下區域，裡面有特別的頭目。這些危險的頭目會掉落深淵聯盟限定的傳奇道具，而這些道具也都有深淵插槽。

TutorialPanelBestiaryContent1.english: Einhar Frey, first found in Act 2, wants your help capturing beasts to place in his Menagerie. Einhar only wants beasts he feels are "worthy" of the First Ones, so he will only appear when there are beasts with Bestiary mods in the area. These are easily identified by their yellow or red icons on the minimap. For Einhar to capture a beast, you must first weaken it through combat.
TutorialPanelBestiaryContent1.zhTW: 埃哈弗爾出現於第二章，他需要你幫忙捕捉野獸以豐富他的獸園。埃哈只想要他認為初始者覺得有「價值」的野獸，所以他只會在野獸有獸獵寓言詞綴的地區。可以很容易透過野獸在小地圖上黃色或紅色圖示來辨識。要讓埃哈捕捉野獸，你必須先透過戰鬥使牠弱化。

TutorialPanelBestiaryContent2.english:
Captured beasts are taken by Einhar to the Menagerie. Your Menagerie is shared across all characters in the same league on the same account, much like a Hideout. Other players can enter your Menagerie if you allow it, and you can enter theirs.

The Menagerie has a small arena with a stone plate, called the Blood Altar. At the Blood Altar you can perform 'Beastcrafting'. This requires that you select a recipe for which you have the required beasts. Once selected, those beasts will attack you in the arena. Successfully defeating those beasts will complete the craft, while death will result in those beasts escaping (and, if you're in a Hardcore league, your character transferring to Standard). 

Recipes can be discovered by capturing beasts, so be sure to capture a wide range of beasts!

Each captured beast, and each unlocked recipe, is also logged in your Bestiary - a document that can be found in your Challenges tab while you are in an area with Einhar or in the Menagerie.
TutorialPanelBestiaryContent2.zhTW:
被獵捕到的野獸會被埃哈帶往獸園。你的獸園會與相同聯盟的所有角色共同持有，像是藏身處。其他玩家在你的允許下可以進入你的獸園，同樣的你也可以進入其他玩家的獸園。

獸園內有個小競技場，內有石頭平台，叫做「鮮血祭壇」。在鮮血祭壇你可以進行「野獸獻祭」。這會需要你選擇獻祭獵譜上你以獲得的野獸。一旦選定，這些野獸將會在競技場內攻擊你。成功將這些野獸擊敗將可完成儀式，死亡的話這些野獸將會逃跑 ( 若你是在專家模式中，你的角色將會被轉移至標準模式 )。

獵捕更多野獸可以解鎖更多獵譜，所以請盡量獵捕各種野獸吧！

每個獵捕的野獸和解鎖的獵譜都會被記錄在你的獸獵寓言中 - 你可以在有埃哈的地區或獸園中，在挑戰成就的面板中找到它。

TutorialPanelBestiaryContent3.english: Eventually you may be able to fight one of the four Spirit Beast bosses, each of which can drop their own special set of unique items. These are the pinnacle fights available through Beastcrafting, and may require that you capture particularly rare beasts.

TutorialPanelStrongboxesContent1.english:
Special chests, called Strongboxes, can be found throughout Path of Exile. Unlike ordinary chests, Strongboxes are protected by monsters that must be defeated before the Strongbox will relinquish its treasures. 

Although Strongboxes are not technically items, they do share some special traits in common with many of Path of Exile's items. Specifically, Strongboxes have mods and, like items, these mods can be changed with the use of currency.

There are several different kinds of Strongbox to find, each one providing different amounts or kinds of items. Here are a few of the more common ones:
TutorialPanelStrongboxesContent1.zhTW:
在流亡黯道旅途中，可以發現一些特別的箱子「保險箱」。不像一般的箱子，保險箱會被一群怪物保護著，一定要打敗怪物後保險箱才會掉落寶物。

雖然保險箱技術上來說不是物品，但它和流亡黯道中的物品有些特殊的關聯性。舉例來說，保險箱像物品一樣有詞綴，也可以用通貨來改變這些詞綴。

保險箱的許多不同的種類，每種都會提供不同的數量或是種類的物品。以下是幾個常見的保險箱類型：

TutorialPanelStrongboxesContent2.english: It is often worth carrying some currency items with you, so you can modify any strongboxes you happen to come across. The difference between a normal Strongbox and a well-crafted magic Strongbox can be quite significant.
TutorialPanelStrongboxesContent2.zhTW: 帶些通貨在身上滿划算的，這樣你可以在遇到保險箱的時候調整成有利的詞綴。一般的保險箱和工藝完美的保險箱是有著相當大的差別。

TutorialPanelFlasksContent1.english: They may not be as flashy as a powerful weapon or armour item, but flasks in Path of Exile will literally mean the difference between life and death.
TutorialPanelFlasksContent1.zhTW: 它們不像武器或護甲裝備一樣強大，但藥劑在流亡黯道對生與死也佔了很重要的一部分。

TutorialPanelFlasksContent2.english:
Flasks in Path of Exile are not consumable items. Unlike Scrolls of Wisdom, when you use a Flask, it does not vanish. Instead, it simply consumes a number of flask charges based on the flask you're using, and, once empty, must be refilled before it can be used again. Flasks can come in normal, magic or unique rarity, but not rare. 

Usually, flasks refill as you slay monsters. This means as long as you're successfully engaging in combat, you should always have a flask or two available for use. But if you get into a spot of trouble and empty your flasks, you'll either have to carefully slay enough monsters to refill them or return to Town. 

Your flasks also refill when you return to Town, so jumping into a portal is a valid strategy when you're running low on flask charges. Some flasks, such as those with the 'Surgeon's' prefix, can be refilled based on other conditions.
TutorialPanelFlasksContent2.zhTW:
流亡黯道的藥劑並不是消耗品。不像知識卷軸，當你使用藥劑的時候不會消失，只會消耗藥劑的充能數量，一旦藥劑空了，就必須要重新充能藥劑後才可以再次使用。藥劑的稀有度有一般、魔法或傳奇，不包含稀有。

通常可以透過擊殺怪物充能藥劑。這表示只要流亡者持續的進行戰鬥，你應該都會有一或兩瓶的藥劑可以使用。但若你陷入危機且你的藥劑已經空了，你就必須要小心的清怪讓藥劑重新充能，或是回到城鎮。

你的藥劑在你回到城鎮後也會完成充能，所以當你的藥劑充能不夠時，逃進傳送門中也是種有效的策略。有些藥劑，像是有「外科醫生的」的前綴，在其他情況下也可以充能藥劑。

TutorialPanelFlasksContent3.english:
Other magic mods can enhance the amount of life or mana a [Flask] restores, or the duration it lasts, or the number of times it can be used. Some also provide extra utilities, such as removing curses or [Ailments]. 

Carefully selecting your flasks and which mods they have is just as important as selecting which weapon to wield or passive skills to take. If ever you are struggling to survive, take a look at your flasks and see if improvements can be made. They are often a cheap and effective place to start solving character build problems.
TutorialPanelFlasksContent3.zhTW:
其他魔法詞綴可強化[Flask|藥劑]的生命或魔力回復量、持續時間，或是可使用次數。其中一些可提供額外功用，像是移除詛咒或[Ailments|異常狀態]。

慎選你的藥劑以及帶有的詞綴，其重要性並不亞於挑選你的武器或天賦。如果你常常死亡，不妨留意一下你的藥劑，看看有沒有能提升的地方。在解決角色流派問題上，藥劑往往是個經濟實惠的選擇。

TutorialPanelFlasksCaption1.english: Carefully consider your flask modifiers. They can make all the difference.
TutorialPanelFlasksCaption1.zhTW: 謹慎選擇你的藥劑詞綴。它們可以使一切都變的不一樣。

TutorialPanelFlasksCaption2.english: It's helpful to have a mix of different flasks for different situations.
TutorialPanelFlasksCaption2.zhTW: 多種藥劑組合對各種情況是很有幫助的。

TutorialPanelFlasksCaption3.english: Flasks are friends! Don't be afraid to use them often.
TutorialPanelFlasksCaption3.zhTW: 藥劑是你的好夥伴！不要害怕使用它們。

TutorialPanelEssencesContent1.english:
You may encounter large blue crystals throughout the world that have imprisoned several monsters. By activating the central crystal you can free the monster within, but beware: that monster has been empowered by an Essence, and will be significantly tougher to kill than usual. If you manage to defeat the monster within, you can claim the essence for yourself. 

Essences are a special type of currency item that can typically only be found by defeating these trapped monsters. Unlike ordinary currency items, Essences have semi-predictable outcomes -- they will always guarantee that a certain mod appears.
TutorialPanelEssencesContent1.zhTW:
在流亡黯道冒險時你可能會遇到被巨大藍色水晶禁錮的怪物。啟動中心的水晶，你將會釋放被禁錮其中的怪物，但請注意：這些怪物都是被精髓強化過的，且會比一般怪物還要難擊殺。若你成攻擊殺這些精髓怪物，你可以取得怪物的精髓。

精髓是個特別的通貨種類，且只可以在擊敗精髓怪物後取得。不像其他一般通貨，精髓有著半預期性的工藝結果，精髓可以保證出現某些特定的詞綴。

TutorialPanelEssencesContent2.english: Essences are particularly useful early on, or when your character needs a certain mod, such as fire resistance. When the usefulness of low-level essences drops away, you can upgrade them by selling three identical essences to a vendor. Doing so will grant you one similar, but more effective, essence.
TutorialPanelEssencesContent2.zhTW: 精髓在早期或是你的角色需要某種詞綴時是相當有用的，像是火焰抗性。當低階的精髓掉落時，你可以將三個相同的精髓販賣給商人來提升精髓的等級。你會獲得類似且更有效用的精髓。

TutorialPanelEssencesCaption1.english: Monsters who carry essences are much more difficult than ordinary monsters. Be careful!
TutorialPanelEssencesCaption1.zhTW: 擁有精髓的怪物會比其他一般怪物還要來的危險。小心點！

TutorialPanelIncursionContent1.english:
Once you have reached Act 7, you may encounter Alva Valai. Alva is trying to find the location of the lost treasure temple of Atzoatl using ancient Waystones that begin appearing from the Causeway onwards. With her help, you will travel back in time two thousand years, to the Temple of Atzoatl during its construction. During this time, you can help influence the temple's construction, so that when you eventually find it, it is filled with glorious treasure.

You'll only have a limited amount of time during this visit to influence the layout of Atzoatl in the present day, but this time can be extended by slaying its inhabitants. Enemies will not drop loot during your Incursions, but once the timer runs out, you'll be returned to the present-day and showered with loot based on how well you did.

There are two primary objectives to pursue during your incursion: Architects and Altars of Passage.
TutorialPanelIncursionContent1.zhTW:
你到達第 7 章後會遇到艾瓦弗萊。艾瓦正試圖找到失落秘寶阿茲瓦特神廟的位置。在她的幫助下，你將回到兩千年前，阿茲瓦特神廟還在建造的時期。在此期間，你可以影響神廟的建設，所以當你找到神廟的時候，裡面將會富含豐富的寶藏。

你只能在有限的時間造訪過去，來影響阿茲瓦特現今的佈局，但可以透過擊殺當地的居民來延長待在過去的時間。在你穿越期間的敵人都不會掉落戰利品，但當時間結束，你將會被傳送回到現今，並且會依據你的表現掉落戰利品。

在穿越期間有兩個主要目標：建造者和通道之壇。

TutorialPanelIncursionContent2.english:
Each chamber in Atzoatl has several walls which could potentially allow it to connect to another chamber. Some of these may already be connected, but many won't. If, during your Incursion, an enemy drops a Stone of Passage, you can pick it up and place it in an Altar of Passage, and it will connect the chamber you are in to an adjacent one.

This is important, because when you visit the Temple of Atzoatl during the present day, you may only be able to reach the chambers you managed to connect in the past!
TutorialPanelIncursionContent2.zhTW:
每個在阿茲瓦特內的房間都有幾面牆，可能可以與其他房間連通。有些可能是已經連結了，但仍有許多是未連結的狀態。若在你穿越的期間，敵人掉落連通之石，你可以撿起後放至於通道之壇上，這將會使房間相連。

這是相當重要的，因為當你造放現今的阿茲瓦特神廟，你只能到達你過去有設法連結的房間！

TutorialPanelIncursionContent3.english:
Within each Incursion you can find two Vaal Architects. By slaying one, you will allow the other to escape and later develop that chamber in their own vision. If the surviving Architect had previously influenced the development of that room, that room will then be upgraded. If not, then that room will change to something within their realm of expertise.

For example, if you land in the Banquet Hall during an incursion and slay the Architect of Fortifications, allowing the Architect of Toxins to survive, the Banquet Hall will become the Poison Garden. If in a later Incursion you land in the Poison Garden and kill the Architect of Iron, again allowing the Architect of Toxins survive, it will be upgraded to the Cultivar Chamber.
TutorialPanelIncursionContent3.zhTW:
每次的穿越你可以找到兩個瓦爾建造者。藉由擊殺其中一個，你將會使另一個脫逃，並使他將此房間發展為屬於他自己的版本。若存活的建造者原先就已經為該房間的發展者，這間房間將會升級。若不是，此房間將會改造為建造者的專業領域。

例如，若你在穿越降落於神廟宴會場並且擊殺壁壘建師，讓毒物建師存活，那麼神廟宴會場將會改造為監獄花園。若你於之後的穿越降落於監獄花園並擊殺鋼鐵建師，讓毒物建師在次存活，那監獄花園將會升級為培育秘室。

TutorialPanelIncursionContent4.english:
The types and tiers of the rooms you help engineer through your Incursions ultimately form the Temple of Atzoatl in the present day. 

Each room has a different effect. Some are purely positive, while others may put you at significant risk for valuable rewards. By upgrading the Cultivar Chamber to the Toxic Grove, for example, you will fill the Temple of Atzoatl with dangerously poisonous plants, but you will also give yourself the opportunity to loot a unique item that can be found nowhere else.
TutorialPanelIncursionContent4.zhTW:
你穿越期間所幫助工程師房間的種類和階級，最終會形成阿茲瓦特神廟現今的樣貌。

每個房間都有不同的效果。有些一定是有利的，但有些會讓你冒著風險而獲取寶物。舉例，將培育秘室升級至劇毒果園，你會使阿茲瓦特神廟布滿危險的有毒植物，但同時也讓你有機會找到其他地方無法找到的傳奇物品。

TutorialPanelIncursionContent5.english:
Once you've performed enough Incursions, Alva will discover the location of Atzoatl, and will offer you the opportunity to go there. At long last, you can explore the temple you helped create, and loot it for all it's worth! 

After you've visited the temple in the present-day, the next time you find Alva in the world, she will offer you the opportunity to start your Incursions all over again, with a new temple layout and with new opportunities to maximise your rewards.
TutorialPanelIncursionContent5.zhTW:
當你執行足夠的穿越任務後，艾瓦將會發現神廟的位置，並會提供你前往神廟的機會。最終，你可以探索你幫忙建造的神廟，並且奪取所有值錢的東西！

在你造訪完畢現今的神廟後，你下次再遇到艾瓦時，她會給你重新再來一次穿越任務的機會，有著全新的神廟佈局和全新的機會來最大化你的報酬。

TutorialPanelIncursionContent6.english:
The Incursion league includes a set of 40 new challenges. When you complete 12 challenges, you will receive the Incursion Bandana. At 24, you will receive the Incursion Cloak. When you complete your 36th challenge, you will receive the Incursion Portal Effect. These cosmetic effects are only obtainable in this league. 

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Incursion Totem Pole decoration to display in your Hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Incursion challenges you completed during the league.
TutorialPanelIncursionContent6.zhTW:
穿越挑戰聯盟中有40項全新挑戰成就。流亡者完成12項挑戰時可獲得頭部特效：穿越時空頭巾。完成24項時可獲得背飾：穿越時空批風。完成36項時可獲得時空之門．穿越時空。這些獎勵都是屬於「穿越挑戰聯盟」限定品。

流亡者在完成19項挑戰成就時，接著每完成3項挑戰，可獲得穿越挑戰聯盟圖騰柱做為藏身處的裝飾。此圖騰將永久展示你在穿越挑戰聯盟中完成的挑戰數量。

TutorialPanelIncursionCaption1.english: Passages which are already open are lit green, while closed passages are lit red.
TutorialPanelIncursionCaption1.zhTW: 開啟的通道會顯示綠色，而關閉的通道會顯示紅色。

TutorialPanelIncursionCaption2.english: Remember where in the chamber the architects are hidden so you don't spend too much time trying to find them!
TutorialPanelIncursionCaption2.zhTW: 切記，房間中的建造者都會躲藏起來，所以你不要花太多時間在尋找他們！

TutorialPanelIncursionCaption3.english: Each Incursion is an opportunity to incrementally shape Atzoatl for your future visit. Plan ahead!
TutorialPanelIncursionCaption3.zhTW: 每次穿越都是讓你在未來造訪阿茲瓦特時報酬變多的機會。請先擬定好計畫！

TutorialPanelDelveContent1.english:
Once you have broken the seal in Highgate and gained access to the mines below, you will begin to encounter veins of Voltaxic Sulphite throughout the world. When you interact with these Voltaxic Sulphite veins, a character called Niko will appear to mine it out of the ground for you. 

Niko operates a mine that was previously abandoned by the Eternal Empire, and wants your help obtaining enough Sulphite to help illuminate the mine. Once you have some Sulphite, you can visit his mine. There are three points of interest at the mine: Niko himself, the Subterranean Chart, and the Generator.
TutorialPanelDelveContent1.zhTW:
一旦你打破在統治者之殿被封印，並前往下方的礦坑，你會在開始在鬼島各處找到魔暴硫酸的礦脈。當你點擊魔暴硫酸礦脈時，一個名叫尼科的人會幫你把它從地面中挖出。

尼科擁有一座礦脈，這礦脈先前被不朽帝國所遺棄，他希望你可以幫忙取得足夠的硫酸來照亮礦脈。一旦你有一些硫酸，你就可以拜訪他的礦脈。礦脈中有三個有趣的點：尼科、地下圖和製電機。

TutorialPanelDelveContent2.english:
To access the mine itself, you need to use the Subterranean Chart device and select the point within the mine you wish to visit. Once there, you will appear next to a mobile machine called Crawler, which is powered by the Voltaxic Sulphite you have collected throughout the world. Use Crawler to select which adjacent area within the mine you would like to explore, and it will start moving in that direction. Be aware that this consumes some amount of Voltaxic Sulphite. 

Along the way to your destination you will encounter monsters and other paths into the dark depths of the mine, and at your destination you may find a difficult fight! Be careful when straying too far from Crawler, because the darkness in this mine is no ordinary darkness!
TutorialPanelDelveContent2.zhTW:
為了前往礦脈，你需要使用地下圖設備並選擇其中你想拜訪的礦脈傳送點。一旦抵達那邊，你身旁會出現一台名為潛伏號的移動機器，它的動力為你在各處蒐集的魔暴硫酸。利用潛伏號選擇礦脈中你想探險相鄰的地區，它就會開始朝該方向移動。請留意，這會消耗一定數量的魔暴硫酸。

前往目的地的途中，沿途會遇到怪物並且其他道路會陷落於礦脈的黑暗中，在目的地你可能會遇到困難的對戰！因為在此礦脈中的黑暗非一般的黑暗，所以當離開潛伏號太遠時，請小心。

TutorialPanelDelveContent3.english:
The darkness in this mine obscures your vision, but it also deals you damage. The damage grows the longer you stay in the darkness, so while short visits into the darkness might be OK, you won't be able to stay in there for long periods.

The monsters within the mine are also empowered by the darkness, and will take massively reduced damage while they dwell within it. Some of the monsters will even use the darkness as a weapon, shutting down nearby lights. But don't worry, you can create some weapons of your own!
TutorialPanelDelveContent3.zhTW:
此礦脈中的黑暗會模糊你的視線，同時對你造成傷害。傷害隨著你待在黑暗中時間越久而越高，所以短暫待在黑暗中是沒問題的，你無法在該處停留太久。

礦脈中的怪物也被黑暗所增強，它們在黑暗處時會減免大量的傷害。有些怪物會使用黑暗作為武器，把附近的光線熄滅。但別擔心，你可以製造一些你自己的武器！

TutorialPanelDelveContent4.english:
With the Azurite you find in the mine you can craft and upgrade flares and dynamite.

Flares are portable light sources that can be thrown to specific locations and last for a short while. You won't get very far through the mine by just throwing flares -- you need Crawler's help for that -- but you can use them to explore areas near your pre-lit paths for valuable treasures.

Dynamite won't provide any light, but can be used to harm enemies and open up new paths. You'll encounter Fractured Walls throughout the mine that can be destroyed with a well-placed stick of dynamite.  Both of these items can be upgraded at the Generator, improving their effectiveness as well as the amount of each that you can carry. It's worth carrying a few on your character when you want to go treasure-hunting in the dark.
TutorialPanelDelveContent4.zhTW:
在礦脈中找到的碧藍礦可以用來工藝和升級閃光和炸藥。

閃光是可攜帶式光源，可以投擲至特定地區並持續一小段時間。你無法使用閃光就探險至礦脈很遠的地區 -- 你需要潛伏號的幫忙 -- 但你可以使用它們來探索先前已經被點亮的道路附近來找到稀有的寶藏。

炸藥不會提供任何光線，但可以用來傷害敵人和開啟新道路。你在礦脈會遇到壁痕之牆，炸藥位置放的好的話可以摧毀它。以上兩個物品都可以在製電機升級，改善他們的效能和你可以攜帶的數量。當你想要當暗影尋寶獵人時，攜帶一些在角色身上是相當划算的喔。

TutorialPanelDelveContent5.english:
While it's fun to explore and slay monsters, the main reason you'll want to explore the Azurite Mine is for the Resonators. Resonators are special crafting items with sockets. They act like Chaos Orbs and come in several different sizes. To use one, you need to find Fossils to socket into them.

It's the Fossils that set Resonators apart from their currency counterparts. Each Fossil socketed into a Resonator in some way influences what the outcome will be when that Resonator is used on an item. See below for an example.
TutorialPanelDelveContent5.zhTW:
當你在碧藍礦坑探險和殺怪得心應手時，你探索礦坑的主要因素就是鑄新儀了。鑄新儀為特殊的附插槽工藝物品。他們像點金石或混沌石的效果，並且有幾種不同大小。要使用的話，你必須找到化石鑲嵌進它。

這是化石，用來使鑄新儀與其他通貨與眾不同。每個化石鑲嵌入鑄新儀後，可以影響未來將鑄新儀使用於物品上的工藝結果。請看下方的範例。

TutorialPanelDelveContent6.english:
The Delve league includes a set of 40 new challenges. When you complete 12 challenges, you will receive the Canary pet. At 24, you will receive the Azurite Back Attachment. When you complete your 36th challenge, you will receive the Delve Portal. These cosmetic effects are only obtainable in this league. 

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Delve Totem Pole decoration to display in your Hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Delve challenges you completed during the league.
TutorialPanelDelveContent6.zhTW:
掘獄挑戰聯盟中有40項全新挑戰成就。流亡者完成12項挑戰時可獲得寵物：金絲雀。完成24項時可獲得武器外觀：掘獄鋤鎬。完成36項時可獲得時空之門．掘獄勇士。這些獎勵都是屬於「掘獄挑戰聯盟」限定品。

流亡者在完成19項挑戰成就時，接著每完成3項挑戰，可獲得掘獄挑戰聯盟圖騰柱做為藏身處的裝飾。此圖騰將永久展示你在掘獄挑戰聯盟中完成的挑戰數量。

TutorialPanelMappingContent5.english:
You may soon find strange patterns on your Atlas, such as swirling tentacles or glittering stars. These are indicators of whose influence those maps are under. Maps concealed by tentacles are under the influence of an entity called The Elder, while maps masked by stars are under the influence of The Shaper.

Each of these entities augment the maps they are influencing, either by adding extra monsters or making the boss fights more difficult. Completing a map that is influenced by one of these entities will remove the influence and may cause the other entity to influence that map instead.
TutorialPanelMappingContent5.zhTW:
你很快的就會在你的輿圖上發現奇怪的標記，像是捲動地觸手獲是閃爍的星星。這些標記表示誰正在控制這張地圖。被觸手環繞的地圖是被名為異界尊師的生物所控制，而被星光遍佈的地圖則是被塑界者控制。

這兩個生物控制的地圖都會被增強，不是有額外的怪物，就是會使頭目戰更加困難。完成被控制的地圖後，控制該地圖的勢力就會被移除，並且可能被另一個生物的勢力所控制。

TutorialPanelMappingContent6.english:
Completing other maps may also grow an entity's influence, though since the Shaper and Elder are at war with each other, you may not always get the outcome you want. If you want to grow The Elder's influence, your best bet may be to target Shaper-influenced areas or areas with no influence at all.

As The Elder's influence grows, you may find that several maps become inhabited by The Elder's guardians. Completing these maps involves tough boss encounters, but if you manage to do it, they may lead to The Elder itself.

Monsters in Shaper- or Elder-influenced maps can drop special versions of items that are also Elder- or Shaper-influenced. These items can roll special (and often very powerful) mods that are not ordinarily available.
TutorialPanelMappingContent6.zhTW:
完成其他地圖也有可能使他們的勢力成長，但因為異界尊師與塑界者雙方正在戰爭，你可能無法一直得到你想要的結果。如果你想要助長尊師的勢力，你最好瞄準塑界者所控制的地區或其他完全沒有被控制的地區。

隨著尊師勢力的成長，你可能會發現有些地圖會被尊師的守護者所佔據。要完成這些地圖會遭遇困難的頭目戰，但如果你完成這些地圖，他們會引導你至尊師。

塑界者或尊師控制地圖中的怪物可能會掉落特殊版本的物品，這些物品都是被塑界者或尊師所影響。這些物品可以出現特殊（有時相當強力）的詞綴，一般的物品是無法取得。

TutorialPanelAtlasObjectivesContent1.english:
When viewing your Atlas you may notice that some maps have large symbols around them. These are Atlas Objectives. Each objective signifies that opening and entering that map will guarantee an encounter with one of the masters.

Each symbol represents the presence of a specific master:
TutorialPanelAtlasObjectivesContent1.zhTW:
當查看你的輿圖時，你可能會注意到部份地圖被大圖示環繞。那就是輿圖日誌。每個日誌表是開啟進入地圖時，保證會有一個大師事件。

每個標示各別代表一個指定的大師：

TutorialPanelAtlasObjectivesContent2.english:
This special property is unique to your Atlas -- a party member can't benefit from the objectives on your Atlas.

The objectives are consumed as soon as you open the associated map. New objectives are guaranteed to appear once a day, but you also have a chance to generate a new objective whenever you complete a map.

New objectives select maps based on the tier of your last completed map, within two tiers. In other words, if you complete a tier 10 map, a new objective may appear on a tier 9, 10 or 11 map. The exceptions are tier 1 maps (which can cause objectives to appear on tiers 1, 2 or 3) and tier 16 maps (which can cause objectives to appear on tiers 14, 15, and 16). They favour maps you have previously completed but may appear on maps not yet revealed.

So if you're looking to find more Voltaxic Sulphite or just want to hunt beasts with Einhar, check your Atlas. You may have a friend waiting for you!
TutorialPanelAtlasObjectivesContent2.zhTW:
此特殊的屬性是你輿圖獨有的 -- 隊伍成員無法從你輿圖上的日誌獲得任何東西。

日誌在你開啟對應的地圖時就會被消耗。每日會刷新一次所有輿圖日誌，但當你完城地圖時，也有機會產生新的日誌。

新日誌會根據你最後完成的地圖來選擇，且在加減 1 階級。換句話說，若你完成階級 10 的地圖，新的日誌可能會出現在階級 9、10、11 的地圖。階級 1 (日誌會出現在階級 1、2、3)和階級 16 (日誌會出現在階級 14、15、16)為例外。偏向會出現在你先前已完成的地圖，但也有機會出現在尚未揭露的地圖。

若你當你急需魔暴硫酸，或只想和埃哈捉地鼠，檢查看看你的輿圖。或許會有個人在等著你喔！

TutorialPanelVeiledItemsContent1.english:
Once you have met Jun Ortoi, you will begin encountering the Immortal Syndicate. If you manage to defeat an Immortal Syndicate member, they may drop a Veiled Item. Veiled Items are special rare items with Veiled Modifiers - modifiers masked by ancient magic that only Jun Ortoi can reveal.

When Jun unveils the modifier, you'll be presented with three different options for what that modifier will ultimately be. Not only are many of these modifiers very powerful, but unveiling them allows you to craft those modifiers using your Crafting Bench in your Hideout! So your choice is very important, even if you have no plans to use the item it appears on.
TutorialPanelVeiledItemsContent1.zhTW:
你遇到瓊恩歐塔時，你將會開始遭遇永生密教事件。若你擊敗永生密教的成員，他們有機會掉落隱匿道具。隱匿道具是有著隱匿詞綴的稀有道具 - 詞綴被古老魔法遮蔽，只有瓊恩歐塔可以揭露。

當瓊恩揭露詞綴，將會出現 3 個不同的詞綴選項來決定物品最終的詞綴。隱匿詞綴不僅有許多強大的詞綴，揭露詞綴的同時也可以讓你在藏身處使用工藝台來工藝這些詞綴。所以你的選擇就相當重要，即使出現的詞綴都不是你想使用在該物品上的。

TutorialPanelVeiledItemsContent2.english:
Veiled modifiers often have multiple tiers, however all tiers of a modifier will be unlocked for crafting when unveiled for the first time. Once you have unlocked a Veiled modifier for crafting, it will be available for all of the characters you create in that league. 

Additionally, some modifiers can only appear on items from specific Immortal Syndicate members. You can check whether a Veiled modifier is from a certain member before you unveil it by looking at the advanced modifier description (enabled in the Options menu).

One final thing to consider: even if you have unlocked all the Veiled modifiers you want, Veiled items still have value -- to other players! Some players may pay a premium for items that have not yet been unveiled, so that they can rapidly learn the recipes! Consider selling Veiled items to other players!
TutorialPanelVeiledItemsContent2.zhTW:
隱匿詞綴通常都會有許多階級，且只能透過揭露相同的詞綴來獲得更高階的詞綴，部分詞綴只會出現在特殊永生密教成員掉落的物品上。你可以在揭露隱匿詞綴前，使用進階詞綴敘述(可以在設定中開啟)可以確認詞綴是來自哪位密教成員。

一旦你解鎖隱匿詞綴，它就可以被你所有於該聯盟的角色所工藝。隱匿詞綴被視為工藝詞綴，即使你沒有工藝過它們。這表示，在一般情況下，你將無法工藝額外的詞綴在你已揭露的道具上。

最後一件事：即使你已經解鎖所有你想要的隱匿詞綴，隱匿道具對於其他玩家仍相當有價值。有些玩家可能會支付高額價錢來購買尚未揭露過的道具，來快速習得配方！可以考慮將物品販賣給其他玩家！
